jobs.description:
**Help Transform the Future of Housing and Urban Planning**
At Archistar, we’re using artificial intelligence to solve one of the world’s biggest challenges: the global housing crisis.


We partner with municipal governments, planning authorities, and property developers to modernize planning systems, streamline development approvals, and accelerate housing delivery through intelligent technology.


Our AI\-powered platform combines spatial analysis, generative design, machine learning, and advanced data visualization to help governments and industry make faster, smarter, and more compliant planning decisions.


As we continue expanding across the United States and North America, we’re looking for an experienced **Senior Project Manager, Government Solutions** based in **Austin, Texas** to lead the successful implementation and delivery of complex enterprise projects for government customers.  

  

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of:

  

* AI and emerging technology
* Government digital transformation
* Urban planning and housing policy
Enterprise SaaS delivery  
* 

You’ll play a critical role in helping governments modernize how cities are planned, approved, and built.

 **The Role**  

  

As a Senior Project Manager at Archistar, you will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise software implementations for government customers across the United States and North America.


You will serve as the primary delivery lead between customers and internal teams ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to customer outcomes.


This role requires strong stakeholder management, project governance, and cross\-functional coordination skills. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and external government stakeholders to drive successful implementation outcomes in complex and politically sensitive environments.


We’re looking for someone who is highly organized, proactive, technically confident, and experienced navigating enterprise or government delivery environments.

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise government implementation projects from contract signature through go\-live and post\-implementation support

* Ensure projects are delivered in alignment with contractual commitments and customer expectations

* Build strong working relationships with customer stakeholders across technical, operational, and executive levels

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Technical teams to translate customer requirements into actionable delivery plans
* Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment throughout implementation

**Change Management \& Adoption**

* Drive customer readiness activities including stakeholder alignment, process redesign support, training coordination, and end\-user adoption

**Delivery Operations \& Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor project performance and proactively identify risks, blockers, and dependencies
* Ensure project milestones and customer acceptance criteria are completed to support invoicing and revenue recognition
* Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery frameworks, implementation methodologies, and operational processes
* Manage multiple concurrent projects across the United States, Canada and Australia

* Proven experience delivering enterprise SaaS, software implementation, or digital transformation projects
* Experience managing complex stakeholder environments across multiple teams and seniority levels
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies including Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills

Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects across time zones and distributed teams

**Preferred Experience**

jobs.title: Affiliate Marketing Project Manager / Executive Admin
jobs.description:
About Clutch Affiliate

Clutch Affiliate is a women\-owned affiliate and partnership marketing agency working with CPG and DTC brands across Amazon, DTC/network affiliate, publisher affiliate, TikTok Shop, and PR affiliate. With remote offices in Tampa, Florida and Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, we run lean and move fast, both with our clients and with each other. If you like clear ownership over your work and don't want corporate red tape, you'll fit in here.

The Role

We're looking for a Project Manager / Admin who can be the connective tissue across Clutch. This role oversees the moving pieces across our full client roster and supports our co\-founders directly, keeping projects, deadlines, and next steps on track internally and with clients. You'll need to be organized, proactive, and comfortable owning the details other people forget to track.

This is not primarily an affiliate marketing execution role. Affiliate marketing knowledge is a bonus, not a requirement, we're happy to train that piece. What matters most is that you're a sharp project manager and administrator who can keep multiple clients and workstreams moving without being told twice.

We're not currently tied to a specific project management platform. If you have strong experience with a PM tool you love (Asana, ClickUp, Monday, Notion, or otherwise) and think it would serve us well, we're genuinely open to adopting it.

If it's a mutual fit, there's real room to grow into full\-time as our client base expands.

What You'll Do

\- Serve as the central point of organization across all client accounts, tracking deliverables, deadlines, and next steps

\- Provide direct administrative support to Clutch's co\-founders, managing schedules, priorities, and follow\-through

\- Keep internal projects on track, flagging what's falling behind before it becomes a problem

\- Coordinate across the team to make sure client needs are being met on time

\- Build and maintain systems (trackers, checklists, calendars) that keep the agency organized as it scales

\- Sit in on client calls as needed to capture next steps and keep projects moving

\- Support affiliate program operations where needed (we'll train you on this as it comes up)

\- Bring ideas to the table on how to make Clutch run more efficiently, not just execute on someone else's

What You Need

\- Strong project management skills, comfortable juggling multiple clients and priorities at once

\- Excellent organizational skills and follow\-through, nothing falls through the cracks on your watch

\- Comfortable providing high\-level administrative support to founders

\- Self\-starter energy. We're not going to micromanage you; we need someone who sees what needs doing and does it

\- Clear, confident communicator, both internally and with clients

\- Genuine interest in helping a small agency run well and grow

Nice to Have

\- Familiarity with affiliate/publisher marketing (CJ, Avantlink, AWIN, or Impact)

\- PR affiliate experience

\- Experience with a PM platform you'd advocate for us adopting

Hours and Structure

Flexible and remote. Potential to expand to full\-time based on performance and agency growth.

Pay

Hourly, based on experience.

To Apply

To help us see who reads instructions carefully, please include the following when you apply:

1\. In your cover letter or application message, name one podcast episode Clutch Affiliate has appeared on (you'll find this on our website at www.clutchaffiliate.com).

2\. Include the phrase "Growth Partner" somewhere in your subject line or application message.

Applications that skip these steps will not be considered.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 8\.0 – 10\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
In the journey of life, your career should make a difference.


At Inizio Evoke, we come together—to do the best work, in the best possible place. We're all in. Because it's everyone's role to make health more human™.


**About the Role**


We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the operating rhythm of Operatev — Inizio Evoke's enterprise AI platform — from the inside out.


This is a high\-visibility, cross\-functional role responsible for keeping the program on schedule and its status transparent. You'll own the connective tissue: sequencing work across Product, Development, Change \& Enablement, Support, Operations, Business Transformation, and Commercialization so that nothing blocks on an unowned handoff and everyone is working from the same picture of where things stand.


You will sit at the center of a program that is building and rolling out a platform to 1,200 people. That means competing priorities, real dependencies, and a delivery pace that doesn't slow down. You will bring strong program management fundamentals in a product development environment, thrive on clarity and structure, and know how to translate complex cross\-functional realities into reporting that actually drives decisions.


This is a remote role reporting to the Program Lead.

  



**What You'll Do:**


***Own Cross\-Team Sequencing***


* Map dependencies across functions — what depends on what, in what order — and monitor progress against that sequence
* Ensure handoffs are owned, surface unresolved blockers early, and drive items to closure or escalation
* Maintain visibility into the implications of sequencing decisions for Product, Development, and all downstream functions

***Run the Quarterly Planning Cycle***


* Gather functional inputs across all workstreams
* Facilitate commitment\-setting and document outcomes
* Translate quarterly commitments into trackable milestones and hold functions accountable to them

***Track Program Resourcing***


* Maintain visibility into where capacity is going against what's committed and manage the program's calendar to proactively address capacity challenges
* Surface trends and anomalies to program leadership before they become problems
* Oversee recruitment process, meeting with talent acquisition for updates and ensuring timely progress through stakeholder participation

***Set and Hold Stage Gate Standards***


* Define the gates work passes through and what evidence clears each one
* Keep functional cadences in sync without taking over internal functional processes (sprint practices, capability lifecycle, etc.)

***Run Delivery Forums***


* Facilitate the weekly initiative update and risk review
* Maintain the risk register and drive items to resolution or escalation
* Track progress against quarterly commitments and hold the reporting cadence

***Define Reporting Standards***


* Establish and maintain the data taxonomy that governs how each function reports its metrics
* Ensure functional outputs roll into one consistent program\-level picture rather than competing narratives

***Own Executive Reporting***


* Prepare and deliver the synthesized program view for executive and steering committee audiences
* Surface where delivery reality constrains what's being asked — clearly and with context

  

**What You'll Bring:**


* 7\+ years of experience in program management, delivery management, or PMO leadership — ideally within a technology platform, transformation, or product delivery context
* Experience running formal planning cycles (quarterly or release\-based) and translating outputs into trackable commitments
* Track record of building and maintaining executive\-level reporting that is trusted and acted on
* Comfortable managing budget and resource visibility — not ownership, but accurate tracking and surfacing of variance
* Background in professional services, agency, consulting, or regulated industry preferred (healthcare, life sciences, or similar)

***Skills***


* Strong program and project management fundamentals — dependency mapping, risk management, stage gates, and cadence management
* Highly organized: you make things visible, structured, and easy to act on
* Strong written and verbal communication; able to translate complexity into clean reporting without losing accuracy
* Comfortable operating in agile/iterative environments where priorities shift and the plan evolves
* Skilled facilitator — able to run productive cross\-functional forums without letting them drift

***Mindset***


* You keep things moving without needing to own everything
* You surface problems early and bring them forward with enough context for a decision
* You enforce standards consistently — not rigidly, but reliably
* You understand the difference between tracking and deciding, and you stay in your lane while making it easy for others to stay in theirs

  

**What We Offer**


* A central, high\-impact role in a program building something genuinely new — an enterprise AI platform designed to change how a 1,200\-person agency does its work
* Direct visibility to executive and steering committee leadership
* A cross\-functional operating environment where your work touches every part of the program
* The opportunity to define and own the operating standards that the program runs on

Inizio Evoke provides an exciting and flexible work environment, great compensation packages and outstanding company paid benefits including medical, dental, 401(k), tuition reimbursement and flexible time off.

**About the role**

The **Project Manager** is a key position within Professional Services and the PMO and acts with integrity and leads by example, serving as the primary point of contact throughout the customer engagement lifecycle. This role is accountable for ensuring the right resources, governance, and methodologies are in place to enable successful planning, execution, and delivery of complex core SaaS system implementations for our clients, ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, on budget, and with high CSAT scores.


In this capacity, the Project Manager partners closely with Customers, Sales Executives, Solution Consultants, Solution Architects, and Software Engineers to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and deliverables align with defined success criteria. By applying project management best practices and adhering to Bullhorn’s PMO processes, the Senior Project Manager defines, drives, and manages the delivery of projects, managing scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and stakeholder expectations to ensure an exceptional customer experience from project initiation through closure.  

  



**A typical day will include...**
---------------------------------

* **Owning the Project Lifecycle:** Lead the planning, execution, and closure of multiple, concurrent, large\-scale client software implementation projects, establishing the necessary governance and structure where none exists.
* **Proactively Drive Clarity and Order:** Quickly assess and gain command over complex, ambiguous, and high\-risk projects, translating chaos into defined, manageable, and executable project plans.
* **Ultimate Accountability:** Serve as the single point of accountability for project status and success. Naturally take ownership of problems and aggressively drive solutions to resolution.
* **Rigorous Risk and Scope Management:** Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks, dependencies, and issues. Firmly manage scope creep and hold both internal and client stakeholders accountable to agreed\-upon project plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Executive\-Level Communicatio** n: Manage client and vendor relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for project status, expectations, and issue resolution with executive and C\-level stakeholders.
* **Financial and Resource Control:** Oversee project budgets, tracking hours and expenses to ensure financial targets are met and providing accurate, predictable and insightful forecasting and reporting.
* **Methodology Adherence:** Apply project management best practices and actively contribute to the development, improvement and standardization of Bullhorn's PMO processes.
* Mentoring and provide guidance to junior project managers or implementation specialists on best practices and project governance.

**This role is a fit for you if...**
------------------------------------

* Have 3\+ years of progressive experience managing complex, external client\-facing software implementation projects, with a significant focus on ERP, HCM, CRM, or large\-scale SaaS solutions with billable utilization targets.
* A proven track record of successfully delivering projects that have a high level of complexity and ambiguity, demonstrating the ability to rapidly impose structure and governance.
* An expertise in defining and managing project scope, schedules, and budgets for large enterprise clients.
* A mastery of various project management methodologies ( *e.g.,* Waterfall, Scrum, Hybrid) and knowing when to apply each to achieve stability.
* A solid understanding of the end\-to\-end implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, configuration, data migration, integration, testing (UAT), and go\-live.
* Have a proficiency with modern project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, SmartSheet) and resource management systems.
* PMP, CSM, or equivalent is highly preferred.

The annual base salary range for this position is $92,002 \- $115,000\. In addition, this role is eligible for an annual target bonus \& a comprehensive benefits package.


**Compensation and Transparency Statement**

The posted range represents the good\-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. Actual pay within the range will be based on factors such as, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business or organizational needs and affordability. In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws we disclose salary ranges in all job postings and provide additional information upon request

jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Manager to support a high volume UX Research organization. This individual will own a portfolio of vendor engagements from initial intake through contract execution, purchase order issuance, and invoicing.



This is an ownership role rather than a traditional project support position. You will be accountable for keeping every engagement moving, proactively following up with stakeholders, identifying and resolving blockers, and communicating progress before being asked.



The team supports more than **700 UX Research projects annually**, creating an opportunity to work across a broad portfolio of high value research initiatives while gaining early visibility into products and experiences being developed across the organization. You will join a collaborative and welcoming team where your ability to make an immediate impact is valued.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Serve as the primary point of contact and guide for UX Researchers navigating vendor and procurement processes
* Own UX Research vendor engagements from intake through SOW creation and execution, PO issuance, and invoicing
* Manage a portfolio of active engagements and ensure each case continues progressing toward completion
* Coordinate across researchers, contract associates, vendors, approvers, and leadership
* Proactively follow up with stakeholders and create urgency when actions or approvals are outstanding
* Identify blockers quickly, recommend solutions, escalate appropriately, and drive issues through resolution

Success in this role requires a strong sense of ownership and urgency. You take action rather than waiting for direction, keep your commitments moving, and close the loop on outstanding items. Your manager and stakeholders know the status of your work because you communicate proactively, not because they need to ask.



You are comfortable operating independently in ambiguity, know when to escalate, and remain persistent when progress depends on someone else. Just as importantly, you bring empathy to the process and help internal stakeholders and external vendors navigate complex systems and competing priorities.


### **Required Qualifications**

The Project Manager, Technical Services provides the main interface between the Customer, the MRO and Willis Lease during the crucial lease return process. The Project Manager coordinates all aspects of the lease return process with all internal and external customers. This position requires the Project Manager to travel to the location of the engine and/or the records as necessary to manage the lease return process, shop visit or purchase of an engine.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Acts as the primary coordinator with Willis Lease Contracts, the Customer, the MRO, and Willis Lease Technical Records to facilitate an engine lease return.
* Acts as the primary point of contact with the customer during the lease return process including any coordination for customer on\-site or MRO visits. Sets up secondary points of contact within Willis Lease for the customer to facilitate engine lease returns.
* Utilizes the Willis Lease Technical Department Procedures to perform the requirements of an engine lease return at remote locations.
* Ensures work performed during the lease return is complete and complies with FAA, EASA and Willis Lease requirements.
* Attends, or delegates as appropriate, the test cell run or On\-wing tests, to ensure engine performance meets lease return requirements. If performance issues arise, the Project Manager is responsible for coordinating resolution with the MRO, Customer and Willis Lease.
* Attends, or delegates as appropriate, Post Test Borescope inspections to ensure serviceability of the engine prior to lease return and works with the Customer, MRO and OEM to resolve any discrepancies.
* Performs, or delegates as appropriate, a detailed inventory of the engine at end of lease to ensure all items shipped with the engine at start of the lease are returned. If any differences are noted, the Project Manager will work with Willis Lease Technical Records to acquire proper certification of installed units. The Project Manager works with the MRO, the Customer, or a Contractor to replace any missing parts in a cost\-effective manner.
* Reviews for accuracy and, as required, makes copies of all data generated by the Customer and the MRO during the lease return process so that the engine may be leased again in a timely manner.
* Acts as the primary coordinator for engine shop visits with the following duties:
* + prepares the work scope and attains a cost estimate from the MRO
	+ provides the MRO with all required data for the shop visit
	+ manages all aspects of the repair to ensure compliance with the work scope and to achieve a cost\-effective repair
	+ reviews the invoice and manages disputes if any

* Attend Industry conferences to stay current on engine programs.
* Other duties as assigned

As the global leader in AI\-powered customer experience assurance, we help some of the world's most recognized brands deliver seamless, reliable, and engaging interactions across voice, digital, messaging, and AI\-powered channels. Every year, our platform helps optimize hundreds of millions of customer journeys, ensuring businesses can confidently deliver exceptional experiences at scale.
  

As enterprises race to deploy agentic AI, the defining question is no longer whether AI can handle customer interactions, it’s whether those interactions can be trusted. Cyara is the confidence layer that answers that question, testing AI agents with AI agents to detect hallucinations, validate decisions, and ensure compliance before failures ever reach your customers.
  

  

Joining Cyara means helping shape the future of customer experience, partnering with some of the world’s biggest brands, and working alongside passionate, talented people who are committed to making every customer interaction better.

The Principal Project Manager is a senior delivery leader within Professional Services, responsible for the rigor, predictability, and outcomes of Cyara’s implementation and services portfolio. * Personally manage select high\-value or high\-complexity accounts, staying close to delivery while building the team’s ability to do the same.

* Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent launches with competing deadlines

The Senior Project Manager will lead complex Federal projects, programs, and transformation initiatives from planning through implementation and closeout. The position integrates mission requirements, scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, resources, governance, contractor performance, and stakeholder decisions to deliver measurable outcomes within the Federal operating environment. This is a fully remote position supporting a government client. The position requires U.S. citizenship and an active Public Trust clearance at the time of application. This position is contingent upon contract award, final staffing requirements, security eligibility, certification requirements, and customer approval, where applicable.

  

Key Responsibilities:

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
As a founding member of our rapidly evolving Project Management team, you will provide end\-to\-end ownership of complex, high\-impact new product development (NPD) programs. You will lead multiple cross\-functional teams through the NPD process from concept to retail launch, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on cost, and on spec.


Because our PMO is a newly established function, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our operational standards, creating deep and meaningful partnerships companywide, and demonstrating project management's strategic value. You serve as a strategic partner, facilitator, and escalation point—driving alignment at leadership levels, navigating high ambiguity, and setting the standard for execution excellence.

**Responsibilities**


Responsibilities are executed in alignment with PMO standards, methodologies, and the Project Management Competency Matrix. Duties include but are not limited to:

* **Project \& Timeline Management:** Own and drive multiple large or complex NPD programs simultaneously through the Phase Gate process. Develop and manage integrated timelines, anticipate delivery risks, and lead cross‑functional teams through trade‑off decisions to protect timing, cost, and scope. This is a leadership role focused on ownership and outcomes, not task execution for other functions. Actively help define and refine our NPD gates and milestones as our PMO matures.

* **Stakeholder Communication:** Provide clear, concise, and strategic project updates to cross‑functional leaders and stakeholders. Influence alignment and decision‑making by clearly communicating risks, trade‑offs, and recommendations.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Lead efforts to strengthen PMO processes, tools, and standards. Identify systemic gaps across teams and drive improvements that enable more predictable, efficient, and scalable product launches. Help design, pilot, and champion new PMO tools, templates, and communication cadences that make the team more efficient.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required (Business, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, or similar).
* Typically 7–10\+ years of professional experience, including extensive ownership of complex NPD programs.

**Technical Skills**

* Expert proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and project management tools.

**Management Skills**

* **Detail‑Oriented:** Manages complex, interdependent project details across multiple programs, anticipating downstream impacts to scope, timing, cost, and quality. Identifies patterns and systemic risks early to prevent escalation and late‑stage disruption.
* **Communication:** Provides clear, concise, and strategic verbal and written communication across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership. Translates complex project dynamics into decision‑ready insights that drive alignment and action.
* **Problem‑Solving:** Anticipates obstacles before they emerge, quickly assesses root causes, and guides teams toward practical, durable solutions that balance business priorities and execution realities.
* **Cross‑Functional Fluency:** Demonstrates deep fluency across Brand, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and other partner functions. Uses this understanding to drive effective collaboration, sound trade‑offs, and strong execution outcomes.
* **Adaptability \& Ambiguity:** Thrives in high‑pressure, fast‑changing environments with competing priorities. Leads teams confidently through ambiguity, maintaining momentum and focus despite shifting inputs or incomplete information.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* **Mediator, not Participant:** Leads as an objective, unbiased truth teller who balances competing functional priorities and interests. Facilitates tough conversations, surfaces hard truths early, and drives fair, informed outcomes aligned to overall business goals.

* **Calm in the Storm:** Maintains composure, clarity, and decisiveness during periods of significant pressure or uncertainty. Sets the tone for teams, helping others remain focused and productive during tight deadlines or critical moments.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Builds strong, trust‑based relationships across the organization and influences outcomes through credibility and expertise. Effectively drives commitment, accountability, and follow‑through without relying on formal authority.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About MonetizeMore**
----------------------


MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture\-first organization driven by four core values: **Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen** (Continuous Improvement), and **Collaboration**. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

  

**About the Role**
------------------


The company is seeking an experienced, systems\-driven **Business Operations Manager** to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end\-to\-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes.  

  

The **Business Operations Manager** will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross\-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization\-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data\- and AI\-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems.

  

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **1\. Process Kaizen \& SOP Governance**

* ### **Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented.**

### **2\. Project Management \& Visibility**

* ### **Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to\-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company\-wide model with long\-term integration into BL L10s.**

### **3\. Product Rollout Support**

* ### **Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go\-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model.**

### **4\. Cross\-Departmental \& Enterprise Client Enablement**

* ### **Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross\-functional commitments visible and actioned.**

### **5\. Data \& Spreadsheet Management**

* ### **Own data pulls and spreadsheet\-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re\-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental.**


**Who You Are**
---------------

* **The Experienced Operator:** You have 4\+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high\-data\-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC).
* **The Systems Builder:** You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably.
* **Data\- and AI\-Fluent:** You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand\-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work.
* **Comfortable with Ambiguity:** You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process.
* **Direct Communicator:** You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **True Flexibility:** Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
* **Professional Development:** Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

**Description**
---------------


Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people\-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.


Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.


**Make an impact — from near or far**


At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.


We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.


**The opportunity**


The Information Security Risk Analyst supports the identification, assessment, and monitoring of information security and privacy\-related risks to help safeguard the University's systems, data, and operations. This role contributes to SNHU's information security risk management program through the application of qualitative and quantitative evaluation of threats, vulnerabilities, and security control effectiveness across systems, vendors, technologies, and business processes.


The Analyst performs risk analyses, maintains accurate risk records within the GRC platform, supports vulnerability and remediation tracking, participates in risk assessments, and contributes to risk reporting and program improvement activities. This role works collaboratively within the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) function, partnering with information security, compliance, audit, privacy, and business stakeholders to ensure risk management activities align with regulatory requirements, institutional policies, organizational priorities, and industry best practices. You will report to the Senior Manager of Information Security Risk and Compliance.


\#LI\-Remote


**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Conduct qualitative and quantitative information security risk assessments across systems, vendors, technologies, and business processes to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and control gaps affecting the University's information security risk posture.
* Maintain accurate risk records, artifacts, and supporting documentation within the University's GRC platform to ensure consistency, quality, and compliance with established risk management processes.
* Collaborate with information security, privacy, compliance, audit, and business stakeholders to coordinate and document risk mitigation activities and track remediation efforts in alignment with regulatory requirements, risk management frameworks, institutional policies, and organizational priorities.
* Analyze and monitor security risks and prepare risk metrics and reports that support ongoing risk visibility and decision\-making.
* Assist in the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of information security risk management and compliance policies, standards, procedures, and operating models that strengthen the University's security and privacy posture.
* Collaborate with GRC leaders to support risk awareness and education initiatives through the identification of key human and organizational risk drivers and the promotion of risk\-informed behaviors required to mitigate them.
* Monitor changes in cybersecurity threats, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices, and apply relevant knowledge to support the ongoing effectiveness and maturity of the University's information security risk management program.
* Other job duties as assigned.

**What We're Looking For:**


* 3\+ years of experience in a related field
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience supporting information security risk management activities for a large enterprise
* Working knowledge of NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) and other common information security risk management practices and frameworks
* Familiarity with higher education industry standards and regulations (e.g. GLBA, FERPA)
* Experience conducting or supporting risk assessments, tracking remediation activities, and maintaining risk records
* Experience analyzing cybersecurity risks, preparing risk\-related documentation and communicating effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Working knowledge of information security governance, policies, standards, and industry best practices

We believe real innovation comes from inclusion \- where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.

The annual pay range for this position is $70,729\.00 \- $113,188\.00\. Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations. We expect this position to be hired in the following target hiring range $78,155\.00 \- $105,739\.00\.
**Exceptional benefits (because you’re exceptional)**


You’re the whole package. Your benefits should be, too. As a full\-time employee at SNHU, you’ll get:


* High\-quality, low\-deductible medical insurance
* Low to no\-cost dental and vision plans
* 5 weeks of paid time off (plus almost a dozen paid holidays)
* Employer\-funded retirement
* Free tuition program
* Parental leave
* Mental health and wellbeing resources

jobs.title: Pharmacy Fraud Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***


The Pharmacy Fraud Program Manager is a member of the Special Investigations Unit responsible for detecting, validating, and investigating suspected fraudulent activity within the pharmacy benefit — including prescribing, dispensing, and pharmacy claims activity — across a wide range of internal and external data sources. This role centers on rigorous data validation — reconciling, cross\-referencing, and stress\-testing information drawn from numerous systems to confirm accuracy, surface inconsistencies, and build defensible investigative findings.


The ideal candidate pairs a deeply inquisitive, investigative mindset with strong analytical discipline and brings genuine pharmacy depth: fluency with pharmacy claims data and pharmacy benefit operations, including NCPDP claim fields, NDCs, quantity and days supply logic, formulary and prior authorization concepts, and prescriber and pharmacy identifiers (NPI, DEA, state license), together with a working knowledge of the regulatory framework governing pharmacy fraud, waste, and abuse.


They are fluent in recognizing pharmacy fraud triggers and red flags — prescribing and dispensing outliers, controlled substance and overutilization patterns, and pharmacy billing schemes — and they actively leverage AI\-assisted detection and validation tools to scale their analysis, prioritize cases, and reduce false positives. This person is comfortable asking hard questions, following the data wherever it leads, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable conclusions.


In addition to the core responsibilities of the Fraud Program Manager role, this position serves as the primary owner of the CFWA relationship with our pharmacy benefit manager, coordinating referrals, reporting, and oversight activities between the organization and CVS. This person will work side by side with the Fraud Program Manager on overall fraud detection and scheme identification.

***Your responsibilities and impact will include:***

**CFWA Relationship Management — CVS**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and relationship owner for the CFWA program with CVS, managing day\-to\-day coordination, escalations, and information exchange.
* Manage the intake, routing, and disposition of CFWA referrals to and from CVS, tracking each referral through resolution and ensuring turnaround times and documentation standards are met.
* Lead recurring CFWA governance touchpoints (e.g., joint operating and workgroup meetings), setting agendas, tracking action items, and driving issues to closure.
* Review CVS\-provided FWA reporting, investigative summaries, audit results, and recovery activity for completeness, accuracy, and consistency with source claims data; challenge findings that are not supported by the data.
* Monitor CVS performance against contractual, delegated, and regulatory FWA obligations; identify gaps, request corrective action, and escalate deficiencies to compliance and leadership.
* Track pharmacy\-level actions performed by CVS under the PBM agreement — including pharmacy audits, prepayment review, claim edits, recoveries, and network termination — confirming that agreed actions were taken and applied correctly, and escalating where they were not.

**Data Validation \& Source Reconciliation**

* Validate, reconcile, and cross\-reference data drawn from numerous and disparate sources — pharmacy and medical claims systems, PBM data feeds, prior authorization and rejected\-claim data, eligibility and enrollment systems, prescriber and pharmacy provider files, third\-party databases, public records, watchlists, internal applications, and external vendor feeds.
* Identify discrepancies, anomalies, and inconsistencies across data sets — including NDC, quantity, days supply, DAW, prescriber NPI, DEA number, and dispensing pharmacy mismatches — and determine whether they indicate error, manipulation, or fraud.
* Establish and maintain data integrity standards for investigations, ensuring findings are accurate, complete, and defensible.
* Trace data lineage across internal systems and PBM\-supplied files, corroborating information against authoritative sources to confirm or refute investigative hypotheses.

**AI\-Assisted Detection \& Validation**

* Use AI\- and machine learning–driven detection tools to flag suspicious patterns, score risk, and surface high\-priority cases for review.
* Validate AI\-generated alerts and model outputs against source claims and clinical data, distinguishing genuine fraud indicators from false positives, data artifacts, and legitimate clinical variation.
* Provide structured feedback to analytics, vendor, and PBM partners to improve model accuracy, tuning, and rule logic over time.
* Stay current on emerging AI\-enabled fraud schemes (e.g., synthetic identities, deepfakes, generated prescriptions or prior authorization documentation, fraudulent e\-prescribing credentials) and adapt detection approaches accordingly.

**Pharmacy Fraud Detection, Triggers \& Red Flags**

* Apply deep knowledge of pharmacy fraud triggers, red flags, and typologies — including prescribing and dispensing patterns — to proactively identify suspicious activity before it escalates.
* Develop, refine, and document indicators and detection criteria based on emerging schemes and investigative learnings.
* Investigate referrals and self\-sourced leads, building complete case referrals supported by validated evidence.

**Case Referrals**

* Conduct thorough data validation into suspected fraudulent activity, documenting methodology, findings, and conclusions.
* Maintain accurate, audit\-ready case records in the case management system.
* Prepare clear written summaries and present findings to leadership, business partners, legal, and, when appropriate, law enforcement or regulatory bodies.

jobs.description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.


CLEAR is seeking a Senior Security Operations Analyst III to join our SOC team to help strengthen our ability to detect, investigate, and respond to evolving security threats. In this role, you'll lead complex investigations, improve CLEAR's threat detection and response capabilities, and serve as a trusted security partner while helping develop the analysts and program around you.

  


***What you'll do:***


* Lead complex investigations of security events across corporate networks, endpoints, data centers, cloud environments, and other critical systems, driving incidents from initial analysis through escalation and remediation
* Develop, tune, and optimize threat detection logic across SIEM, EDR, and other security platforms, proactively identifying coverage gaps, reducing false positives, and improving the fidelity of security alerts
* Partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, and other teams to investigate threats, identify root causes, communicate risk, and drive timely remediation and improvements to CLEAR's security posture
* Apply threat intelligence, data, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to identify emerging attack patterns, accelerate investigations, improve detection workflows, and strengthen decision\-making while applying sound security judgment
* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for other analysts, mentoring junior team members, sharing knowledge, and helping establish scalable processes, playbooks, and standards for threat detection and analysis
* Continuously evaluate CLEAR's detection coverage against the evolving threat landscape and frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK, identifying opportunities to improve visibility and proactively defend against emerging threats
* Lead improvements to Security Operations workflows, standard operating procedures, documentation, and tooling to increase the quality, consistency, and efficiency of threat analysis and incident response
* Clearly communicate technical findings, risk, and recommended actions to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, tailoring the level of detail to the audience
* Participate in the Security Operations on\-call rotation and respond to critical security events and incidents outside of standard working hours, as needed

  


***How you'll measure success:***


* High\-quality, accurate investigations that lead to timely containment, remediation, and actionable security improvements
* Measurable improvements in Security Operations workflows, detection logic, automation, and analyst efficiency
* Increased team capability through effective mentorship, knowledge sharing, documentation, and scalable operating practices
* Improved detection coverage, alert fidelity, and time to identify and respond to security threats

  


***What you're great at:***


* 8\+ years of cybersecurity experience, including 5\+ years in security operations, threat detection, incident response, or a related discipline
* Deep knowledge of SIEM, EDR, and security monitoring technologies, with demonstrated experience investigating complex events and developing, tuning, and optimizing detection logic
* Applying threat intelligence and frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK, NIST CSF, or ISO 27001 to identify adversary behavior, evaluate detection coverage, and strengthen security controls
* Using data, automation, scripting, and AI\-enabled security tools to improve threat detection and investigation workflows while applying strong analytical judgment to validate findings and make informed decisions
* Solving complex security problems independently, communicating findings clearly, building trusted cross\-functional relationships, and mentoring other analysts
* Certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, OSCP are a plus
* Experience working across teams and functions to deliver on strategic, program\-level goals

  


***How You'll be Rewarded:***



At CLEAR, we help YOU move forward \- because when you're at your best, we're at our best. You'll work with talented team members motivated by our mission of making experiences safer and easier. Our offices are bright and energetic with an open concept and plenty of conference rooms and casual co\-working spaces. We also offer catered lunches every day and have fully stocked kitchens. Outside of the office, we invest in your well\-being and learning \& development with stipends and reimbursement programs.



We offer holistic total rewards, including comprehensive healthcare plans, family\-building benefits (fertility and adoption/surrogacy support), flexible time off, annual wellness stipend, free OneMedical memberships for you and your dependents, a CLEAR Plus membership, and a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match. The base salary range for this role is $145,000 \- $170,000, depending on levels of skills and experience.

jobs.title: Maritime Project Manager - Hybrid
jobs.description:
SMX is seeking a Maritime Project Manager to join the integrated program management office (PMO) and support the Global Defense programs. This position is responsible for the management and direction of the day\-to\-day operations of contract cost, schedule, and performance execution for Maritime Operations. The ideal candidate will provide leadership to the program team on staffing, training, administrative oversight, operations management, workforce management, budgets, sub\-contracting, and property management. The position requires periodic travel to customer\-designated work sites.


**This position requires a DoD TS/SCI clearance which requires US citizenship for work on DoD contracts.**


**Relocation assistance may be available for the ideal candidate.**


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Allocates appropriate resources to ensure projects are completed within given time and budget
* Utilizes corporate QMS processes to track program/project schedule and cost
* Reports status, develops program/project\-related documentation, implements lessons learned and updates and maintains production and quality metrics for assigned program and projects
* Supports the Global Defense Business Unit with business development activities to include new market capture opportunities and proposal development
* Identifies and supports the capture of additional workshare within current contracts
* Identifies and shapes prime and subcontract opportunities for SMX with customers in current and emerging markets
* Conducts operational planning, execution and evaluation of a multi\-faceted program that requires collaboration with customers to identify new project opportunities
* Orchestrates/develops operational data calls, report outs, and performance products as required to support and bolster SMX posture for current and future business
* Ensures that contract service, quality, and performance requirements are met and compliance with standard operating procedures (SOP) is maintained
* Advises of any contractual issues that may result in Contracting Office action and of any anticipated or proposed adverse personnel actions
* Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with the Government's program managers, Contracting Officers (CO), CO Representatives (COR), and Alternate CORs in support of the Program
* Works cooperatively with PMO leadership to develop short\- and long\-range goals, objectives, policies, and operating procedures in accordance with contract parameters
* Works with human resources and talent acquisition to manage and oversee the recruitment, hiring, retention and development, training, and compensation of employees to assure compliance with contract requirements and HR policies


**Required Skills/Experience**


* TS/SCI eligibility
* Bachelor's degree in business, management, or a related discipline OR Relevant experience can be substituted for a degree
* Previous experience in C6ISR operations, preferably in a leadership role
* Previous experience in managing Maritime Operations and port logistics, preferably in a leadership role
* Able to communicate objectives and requirements effectively to military and civilian personnel
* Experience interacting with and briefing senior government and industry acquisition leaders on topics related to programmatic, technology and financial status
* Knowledge of process improvement techniques and ability to direct improvement initiatives
* Budget management and execution experience
* Business development and technical proposal writing skills
* Previous experience supporting large contracts leading complex development, production, fielding of platforms, and/or support initiatives with technical objectives
* Skilled coordinator of many different organizations and entities operating on a constantly daily updating schedule
* Customer focused
* Capacity to learn rapidly and adapt quickly to change


**Desired Skills/Experience**


* 10\+ years of management/supervision experience in aviation/maritime\-related operations, logistics, or engineering fields/programs
* Current Project Management Institute (PMI) Project Management Professional, Program Management Professional (PMP) or Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) Level III Program Management certification, or ability to complete PMP requirements within 6 months of onboarding
* Experience with SOF operations preferred


 \#CJPOST

  




At SMX®, we are a team of technical and domain experts dedicated to enabling your mission. From priority national security initiatives for the DoD to highly assured and compliant solutions for healthcare, we understand that digital transformation is key to your future success.

Our delivery model and unique approaches harness our deep technical and domain knowledge, providing forward\-looking insights and practical solutions to power secure mission acceleration.



SMX is an Equal Opportunity employer including disabilities and veterans.



Selected applicant may be subject to a background investigation and/or education verification.



SMX does not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization or immigration related support for this position (i.e. H1B, F\-1 OPT, F\-1 STEM OPT, F\-1 CPT, J\-1, TN, E\-2, E\-3, L\-1 and O\-1, or any EADs or other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).

**Job Description Summary:**


The Assistant Commissioning Manager supports the planning, execution, and oversight of testing and commissioning activities for SOLV Energy’s High‑Voltage (HV), Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), and Photovoltaic (PV) projects. In this role, you will work closely with the Commissioning Manager and technical subject‑matter experts to ensure all systems and components are installed, tested, and commissioned in accordance with project requirements, safety standards, and industry best practices. The Assistant Commissioning Manager helps manage project‑level commissioning teams and coordinates with cross‑functional stakeholders to ensure a seamless transition from commissioning through project closeout. This position plays a key role in delivering high‑quality, reliable, and fully operable renewable energy assets.

Program Manager, USDA BioPreferred Program Support

**Anticipated Position, Contingent Upon Contract Award**

About the Opportunity

Shield Analysis Technology, LLC is seeking an experienced Program Manager to join our proposed team supporting the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) BioPreferred Program. This is an opportunity to lead a multidisciplinary team supporting a Federal program that promotes the purchase and use of biobased products.

We are looking for a collaborative leader who can bring structure to complex work, build strong relationships with Government stakeholders, support a diverse technical team, and keep performance aligned with contract requirements.

The position will be hybrid, with travel anticipated two to three times per year depending on the selected candidate’s location. The anticipated start date is 9/30/2026, schedule, and level of effort will be confirmed following contract award.

What You Will Do

As the Program Manager, you will serve as Shield’s primary leader and point of accountability for the anticipated USDA BioPreferred Program support contract. You will guide planning, staffing, performance, quality, financial management, and communication across the contract.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Lead the overall planning and execution of the anticipated USDA BioPreferred Program support contract.
* Serve as Shield’s primary point of contact for the Contracting Officer and Contracting Officer’s Representative.
* Develop and maintain program plans, schedules, staffing assignments, workflows, budgets, performance measures, and reporting procedures.
* Translate contract requirements into clear assignments, milestones, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.
* Lead and support an interdisciplinary team providing program management, Federal procurement, biobased\-product technical support, economic analysis, regulatory development, training, website content, outreach, and data analysis.
* Monitor staffing, schedules, expenditures, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with USDA personnel, Enterprise Applications Services, laboratories, technical specialists, subcontractors, and other authorized stakeholders.
* Oversee support for BioPreferred Program audits, including scheduling, Government approval points, website\-readiness activities, and audit communications.
* Guide the preparation and review of monthly status reports, quarterly performance reports, strategic analyses, presentations, plans, meeting materials, and other required deliverables.
* Coordinate analytical studies, cost\-benefit analyses, technical assessments, program evaluations, and performance\-measurement activities.
* Oversee specialist contributions to economic\-impact studies, Federal procurement initiatives, biobased\-product testing, regulatory development, training, and outreach.
* Establish practical quality\-control procedures that help the team produce accurate, complete, clear, timely, and properly formatted work.
* Identify technical, operational, staffing, quality, and schedule risks early and work with the team and Government stakeholders to develop practical solutions.
* Lead meetings, workshops, performance reviews, lessons\-learned activities, and stakeholder briefings.
* Ensure that Shield personnel and partners follow applicable contract requirements, Federal policies, data\-protection requirements, and Section 508 accessibility standards.
* Maintain appropriate contractor and Government roles. The team will provide advice and assistance while USDA retains final decision\-making and approval authority.

What We Are Looking For

The anticipated solicitation requires:

* A master’s degree in Environmental Sciences, Economics, or an equivalent field.
* At least 10 years of leadership experience, including extensive contract\-management experience.
* Strong management and leadership experience demonstrated through a combination of:
* Strategic planning
* Project or program management
* Information technology
* Program evaluation
* Contract management
* Financial management
* At least five years of experience supporting Federal agencies in areas related to:
* Strategic planning
* Federal policy
* Procurement policy
* Information technology
* Program evaluation
* Implementation of statutory requirements and Executive Orders

jobs.title: Financial and Operations Analyst (TS/SCI #26-151)
jobs.description:
Strategic Analysis is seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented Financial \& Operations Analyst to provide dedicated program\-level financial execution support to a Government Program Manager (PM). In this role, you will be part of the program office's primary financial execution team \-translating PM budget allocations, spend plans, and programmatic milestones into timely, compliant, and auditable financial transactions. The ideal candidate possesses deep, hands\-on experience executing financial vehicles across the full funding lifecycle, including preparing and routing Purchase Requests (PRs), Military Interdepartmental Purchase Requests (MIPRs \- DD Form 448/448\-2\), and Interagency Agreements (FS Form 7600A/7600B) via Treasury's G\-Invoicing platform. You will serve as the financial bridge between the Program Office, servicing contracting activities, performing organizations (e.g., National Labs, FFRDCs, DoD test ranges), and external agency partners to ensure maximum obligation efficiency and compliance with DoD Financial Management Regulations (DoD FMR).

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Execute day\-to\-day funding and procurement documentation based on PM guidance and approved budget execution plans, including Purchase Requisitions (PRs), MIPRs (Direct Cite and Reimbursable), and Interagency Agreements (IAAs).
* Lead the drafting, package coordination, routing, and tracking of FS Form 7600A (General Terms \& Conditions) and FS Form 7600B (Order Requirements and Funding Information) through the Department of the Treasury's G\-Invoicing portal.
* Manage the end\-to\-end processing of DD Form 448 (MIPR) and coordinate with performing/servicing agencies to obtain and record accepted DD Form 448\-2 (Acceptance of MIPR) in a timely manner.
* Assemble comprehensive, audit\-ready funding packages with all necessary supporting artifacts (e.g., SOW/PWS, Independent Government Cost Estimates \[IGCE], justification and authorization \[J\&A], determinations and findings \[D\&F]).
* Serve as the frontline interface with Contracting Officers (KOs), Contracting Officer Representatives (CORs), and external performing agencies to resolve administrative and funding bottlenecks.
* Track commitments, obligations, expenses, and disbursements (COED) against approved spend plans across multiple fiscal years, colors of money (RDT\&E, O\&M, Procurement), and funding appropriations.
* Monitor program execution benchmarks (e.g., OSD obligation and expenditure goals) to identify potential funding withholdings, decrements, or under\-execution risks; formulate actionable recovery strategies for the PM.
* Track contract funding burn rates, invoice status, and unliquidated obligations (ULOs); lead monthly invoice reviews and de\-obligation actions for excess funds.
* Coordinate and support Triannual Reviews (TAR) to validate open commitments and unliquidated obligations, ensuring strict adherence to the Financial Improvement and Audit Remediation (FIAR) standards.
* Input, track, and reconcile financial transactions within government enterprise resource planning (ERP) and financial accounting systems (e.g., DAI, GFEBS, DEAMS, or agency\-specific equivalents).
* Monitor buy/sell activity, intragovernmental performance transactions, and financial clearinghouse workflows inside G\-Invoicing, resolving billing and receipt discrepancies with buyer/seller partners.
* Maintain consolidated program office budget trackers, ledgers, and contract register databases in Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, or internal program tools.
* Generate recurring and ad\-hoc financial execution reports, burn\-rate charts, and executive dashboards for the PM, Deputy PM, and division leadership.
* Support mid\-year reviews, Program Objective Memorandum (POM) inputs, end\-of\-fiscal\-year (EOY) execution sprints, and urgent leadership financial drills.
* Participate in program status meetings, acquisition milestone reviews, and integrated baseline reviews (IBRs) to provide real\-time budget and funding status.


  

**Required Qualifications:*** Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility and an active Counterintelligence (CI) Polygraph (or ability to pass a CI Polygraph prior to onboarding).
* Education \& Experience:
* Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Acquisition Management, Economics, or a related discipline.
* 5\-7 years of direct experience in DoD or Intelligence Community (IC) budget execution, program financial management, or financial SETA/A\&AS support. (Equivalent combination of specialized experience and military/DoD financial management may substitute).
* Specialized Financial Execution Expertise:
* Demonstrated, hands\-on experience preparing, tracking, and processing Purchase Requests (PRs) and Military Interdepartmental Purchase Requests (MIPRs / DD Form 448 \& 448\-2\).
* Direct experience with Interagency Agreements (IAAs) using FS Form 7600A and FS Form 7600B.
* Working knowledge and proficiency with the Treasury's G\-Invoicing platform for intragovernmental buy/sell transactions.
* Knowledge of Regulations \& Policies:
* Solid understanding of the DoD Financial Management Regulation (DoD FMR 7000\.14\-R), FAR/DFARS fiscal principles, Antideficiency Act (ADA), Purpose Statute, and Bona Fide Needs Rule.
* Familiarity with different appropriations/colors of money (RDT\&E, Procurement, O\&M) and their respective statutory life cycles and obligation/expenditure thresholds.
* Technical Skills:
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, nested formulas, financial modeling, dynamic charts).
* Working knowledge of government financial/acquisition platforms (e.g., DAI, GFEBS, DEAMS, PRISM, WAWF/PIEE, or equivalent IC/DoD tools)

All\-Source Intelligence Analyst**The Opportunity:**

With all the information available today, it takes a skilled intelligence analyst to know how to find and interpret the best data to give their clients the right answers. With the critical decisions made in our government every day, we need an intel analyst like you to do just that. As an All\-Source Intelligence Analyst, you’ll use your specialized functional experience and attention to detail to develop intelligence products to give your clients the actionable intelligence and context they need. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem\-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to support our warfighters.


As an All\-Source Intelligence Analyst on our team, you’ll help your client by providing intelligence support to plans, operations, and exercises and illuminating threat trends and indicators through intelligence production and briefings. Using your comprehensive understanding of all\-source intelligence analysis, cyberspace, IC tools, and databases, you’ll research, analyze, and evaluate classified reporting and produce finished intelligence and other data to assess the operational environment and meet CCMD and component organizations’ intelligence and information gaps.


As an authority on your topic, your client will look to you for time\-critical analysis, often under pressure. This is a chance to grow your expertise and broaden your skill set in areas like research, analysis, and writing. You’ll share your expertise with other analysts through leadership and mentoring. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have the resources to learn new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our warfighters and nation’s leaders.


Join us. The world can’t wait.

* 8\+ years of experience in all\-source intelligence analysis
* Experience writing finished intelligence products
* Experience applying all\-source analytic tradecraft standards, including ICD 203 and 206
* Experience briefing senior military and government officials
* Experience collaborating with DoD or IC counterparts to produce finished intelligence
* Knowledge of cyber operations, threat actors, and technological trends
* Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam
* Bachelor’s degree

jobs.title: Cyber Threat Analyst
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**


Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **About The Role**


Peraton is seeking a Cyber Threat Analyst in our Linthicum, MD office in support of our Department of Defense (DoD) customer as part of a highly talented, highly motivated, and high\-performing team. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of cyber investigations, digital forensics, cyber threat analysis, and mission support in a dynamic and collaborative environment. The successful candidate will contribute to protecting national security interests by leveraging technical expertise, analytical skills, and innovative problem\-solving to address complex cyber challenges. Individuals who are passionate about cybersecurity, committed to excellence, and eager to make a meaningful impact are encouraged to apply.

  

Key Responsibilities:


* **Cyber Threat Analysis**: Analyze and interpret cyber threat intelligence with a focus on threats impacting the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). Identify potential risks and vulnerabilities affecting defense contractors and their supply chains.
* **Reporting**: Prepare detailed reports and briefings on cyber incidents, threat analysis, and investigative findings with particular emphasis on impacts to the DIB. Communicate findings and recommendations to senior officials and stakeholders.
* **Incident Response**: Triage, analysis and support incident response activities related to cybersecurity incidents affecting the DIB, including detection, analysis, and mitigation of breaches or attacks.
* **Collaboration**: Work closely with DIB and interagency partners to share information and coordinate response efforts. Facilitate communication and support to defense contractors as needed.
* **Tool Utilization**: Use cybersecurity tools and technologies to conduct fusion analysis; performs queries, pivots on indicators, and research malware characteristics (Message\-Digest Algorithm 5 (MD5\), Secure Hash Algorithm 1 (SHA1\), file size, file name, file paths, etc.). May leverage tools such as Analyst1, Kibana, Virus Total, Recorded Future, etc.
* **Continuous Improvement**: Contribute to the development and enhancement of cyber investigation methodologies, tools, and processes, with a particular focus on improving security within the DIB.
##### **Qualifications**


* **Clearance requirement:** Active/current Secret (TS/SCI preferred).
* **Education:** Associates degree and 7\+ years of experience; OR Bachelor’s degree and 5\+ years of experience; OR Master’s Degree and 3\+ years of experience. Or 0 years with PhD. However, four (4\) years of additional relevant experience or specialized training will be considered in lieu of a Bachelor’s degree. Relevant certifications (e.g., CYSA\+, CISSP, CEH, CISM) are preferred.
* **Experience:** Experience in cybersecurity analysis, incident response, or digital forensics. Requires a detailed knowledge of Department of Defense and service level (Army, Navy, Air Force) intelligence communities, including collection methods, production resources, and responsibilities. Knowledge of advanced persistent threats (APTs), Tactics Techniques and Procedures (TTPs)
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in cybersecurity tools and technologies (e.g., Virus Total, Domain Tools, SIEM, IDS/IPS, forensic analysis tools). Knowledge of operating systems, network protocols, cyber threat actors, cyber kill chain, Indicator of Compromises (IOCs) and MITRE ATT\&CK framework
* **Analytical Skills:** Requires skills and abilities in supervising the handling classified information. Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and provide actionable insights.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information and threat impacts to non\-technical audiences and stakeholders. Requires prior experience briefing information to decision\-makers and leaders. Uses Jira to track analysis tasks and communicate status.
* **Team Player:** Ability to work effectively in a team environment and collaborate with various stakeholders, including those in the DIB. Provides mentorship to less\-senior analysts.
##### **Details**


**Target Salary Range:** $86,000 \- $138,000\. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.


**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.
