jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Intelligence Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers' most pressing national security requirements.  

  

**ABOUT THE JOB**  

  

As an AIS Technical Program Manager, you will lead the development and/or integration of Anduril products and technologies with various government and industry partners. These projects will be diverse in nature and require you to be organized and flexible to adapt to changing situations. On one project, you may be working with the customer to clarify how each of its mission requirements can be met through Anduril's core products, including the plan, scope, and work required. In another situation, you may be helping to craft a vision with the customer or participating in technical working groups with a collaborative set of engineers to transform that vision into an operational reality. During all this, you must be able to successfully work with both external and internal stakeholders, communicate plans clearly to all parties, and support and coordinate across teams to achieve the desired end state.  

  

Success in this position also hinges on two key facets: 1\) systems and engineering mindset—the ability to understand and assess technical concepts—identifying system dependencies, interfaces, technical risks and the impact of key architectural decisions with the engineering team is a must; and 2\) an execution mindset—digging into the details, charting the path and owning the outcome. You will be expected to utilize your technical aptitude in conjunction with your program and project management skills to deliver the best outcome for Anduril and the customer.  

  

We are seeking a TPM with prior training and experience in a relevant engineering field to plan, direct, and lead internal and external program activities. The TPM will interact daily with the Chief Engineer to coordinate the execution of program initiatives and tasks—working alongside the rest of the team to meet the program's administrative, technical, and operational requirements.  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

  

In AIS, our TPMs are high\-agency leaders who bridge the gap between complex engineering and mission execution. Operating at the intersection of hardware and software, TPMs do not just track tasks—they actively drive the development, testing, and deployment of cutting\-edge technologies at insane speed.  

  

Day in and day out, we expect our TPMs to act as force multipliers vice passive coordinators. They possess a deep technical baseline that allows them to challenge engineering assumptions, speak the language of developers and hardware designers, and relentlessly focus on delivering our life\-saving capabilities to the warfighter.  

  

Our TPMs own the following core responsibilities:  

  

**Drive Cross\-Functional Execution:**


* Orchestrate the end\-to\-end path to flight/fielding, driving alignment across structural, electrical, GNC, autonomy, and payload teams from blank\-sheet architecture through Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) testing and range operations.
* Act as the connective tissue across deep domain experts; aggressively uncover and resolve interface mismatches, boundary disputes, and integration gaps before they become program\-halting blockers.
* Bridge the gap between disparate engineering cycles—aligning rapid, iterative software sprint releases with long\-lead mechanical fabrication, PCB spins, and integration milestones to ensure continuous delivery.


**Risk Mitigation \& Problem Solving:**


* Proactively identify technical, supply chain, and schedule bottlenecks.
* Roll up their sleeves to help engineering teams unblock issues and make technical trade\-offs.
* Convert abstract technical, integration, and operational risks into concrete burn\-down plans with explicit ownership, aggressive timelines, and measurable exit criteria.
* In conjunction with the Chief Engineer, anticipate single points of failure across technical architectures and critical path components; build proactive fallback options (e.g., drop\-in hardware alternatives, modular software mocks) before risks materialize.
* Apply first\-principles thinking to break technical impasses, balancing speed\-to\-fleet, unit cost, and system reliability against mission requirements.


**Deliverables Owner:**


* Drive the contract deliverables process during the contract implementation period as well as during ongoing operations.
* Work with internal stakeholders and data management resources daily to ensure accurate development and timely submission of government deliverables, and ensure deliverables are contractually compliant, edited, approved, and submitted on time.
* Assist with the development of Forward\-Looking Metrics and Trend Analysis to produce informative, easy\-to\-assimilate reports from the operational reporting systems, including written summary reports for Management.
* This reporting also allows th

As a pioneering leader in advanced separation technologies, Komline has established a global reputation for engineering excellence. Through our combination of innovative design, cutting\-edge manufacturing capabilities, and decades of industry experience, we consistently deliver the highest quality equipment from our integrated manufacturing facilities. jobs.description:
Amentum is seeking an experienced **Senior Program Manager (Sr. PM)** to lead efforts supporting projects both domestically (CONUS) and internationally (OCONUS). The Sr. PM will oversee every facet of the deployment, management, and operational oversight of contractor support personnel, ensuring the success of critical secure facility design, construction, and engineering support projects. The Sr. PM will be responsible for profit and loss (P\&L) accountability, driving financial performance on assigned projects and ensuring business targets are met.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Lead Program Management Efforts**: Provide comprehensive support by coordinating and collaborating across multiple tasks, activities, and requirements while addressing issues related to program scope, cost, performance, quality, schedule, and risk.
* **Strategic Planning and Implementation**: Develop detailed program plans, schedules, and documentation of requirements to ensure seamless execution of secure design and construction projects.
* **P\&L Management:** Maintain overall financial accountability for assigned programs. Create, monitor, and manage budgets; track project revenues, costs, and profits; and regularly report on financial status to senior leadership. Identify cost\-saving opportunities and implement strategies to achieve financial objectives while maintaining competitive service delivery.
* **Monitor and Adapt to Customer Needs**: Review customer contract requirements and feedback to proactively adjust program strategies. Identify issues, mitigate risks, and ensure timely delivery of services that meet or exceed customer expectations.
* **Performance Monitoring**: Use program management best practices to monitor cost, schedule, and performance metrics, identifying variances and implementing necessary corrective actions.
* **Personnel Management**: Identify, recruit, and propose highly skilled, cleared personnel to meet mission\-critical requirements expeditiously. Ensure continuity of support during personnel changes, while effectively aligning task order staffing.
* **Stakeholder Relations**: Serve as the primary customer point of contact, maintaining proactive, consistent, and transparent communication with key stakeholders.
* **Operational Oversight**: Monitor work processes, methods, budgets, and performance metrics to improve cost\-effectiveness, operational efficiency, and compliance. Oversee environmental, health, and safety functions to ensure safe work practices.
* **Continuous Improvement**: Continuously review systems, resources, procedures, and methods to improve operational effectiveness, efficiency, and overall customer satisfaction.

**Project Details:**

* Work will require the flexibility to lead operations efficiently in a variety of environments. The role will require frequent communication with customers in both CONUS and OCONUS project sites, with potential travel to these locations.

**Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):**

* **Clearance Required**: Active **TS/SCI with Polygraph**.
* **Education**: Bachelor’s degree in a related field (BS).
* **Experience**:


	+ 12\+ years of leadership experience managing large\-scale efforts valued at **$25M\+**, with demonstrated expertise in program management for secure design, construction, or related fields.
	+ Proven ability to lead teams effectively and adapt to dynamic project or customer requirements.
	+ Proven track record of managing complex projects and maintaining P\&L responsibility, ensuring financial targets are met.
	+ Strong interpersonal and written communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders and deliver stakeholder satisfaction.
* **Program Execution Skills**: Demonstrated expertise in budget management, scheduling, risk mitigation, logistics, contractor oversight, and quality assurance in alignment with high\-security requirements.
* **Technical Acumen**: Foundation in security requirements for design and construction in classified and operationally sensitive environments is desired. Experience with approved best practices in program and construction management required.
* **Financial Acumen**: Demonstrated ability to manage project financials, including budgets, schedules, resource allocation, and performance targets for profitability and success.
* **Certification**: Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Leadership Excellence**: Experience working on classified projects globally and successfully managing cross\-functional teams in high\-security government environments.
* Familiarity with DoD, IC, or U.S. Government construction, engineering, and logistics protocols is a plus.

**Additional Expectations:**

* **Travel**: Willingness and ability to travel to OCONUS locations as required to lead project delivery.
* **Work Environment**: Adaptable to challenging environments while maintaining composure and safety standards.
* **Commitment to Excellence**: Demonstrates the highest ethical, professional, and performance standards while ensuring all projects are executed with precision and in compliance with classifications, industry standards, and client demands.

jobs.title: Data Analyst - Risk Adjustment Analytics | Analytics and Insights Engineer III
jobs.description:
Our Deloitte AI \& Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  

  

**Work You'll Do**  

  

As a Project Delivery Analytics and Insights Engineer III on the project, you will:  

* Support risk adjustment analytics, data validation, and business analysis across healthcare datasets.
* Perform exploratory analysis across claims, enrollment, and related healthcare datasets
* Conduct data profiling and assess data quality, completeness, and consistency
* Develop filtering logic and segmented views to support validation and business questions
* Analyze KPIs and performance trends related to risk adjustment and population outcomes
* Support cohort segmentation and targeted analytical investigations
* Identify anomalies, summarize findings, and communicate implications clearly
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to support validation efforts and analytical decision\-making
* Help develop repeatable analytical approaches for ongoing reporting and issue resolution

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The team**  

  

Deloitte's Government \& Public Services (GPS) practice \- our people, ideas, technology and outcomes \- is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, \& local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.  

  

Our AI \& Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting\-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.  

  

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery\-focused professionals.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

Required**:**  

* Bachelor's degree
* 3\+ years of experience in healthcare data analysis or analytics support
* 3\+ years of strong SQL skills
* 3\+ years of experience working with healthcare claims, enrollment, and performance measurement data
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
* Ability to travel 15\-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

  

Preferred:  

* 2 years of experience with Medicare, risk adjustment, or value\-based care analytics
* 1\+ year of Python or R for deeper analysis and repeatable workflows
* 2 years of experience supporting validation efforts in healthcare analytics environments

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $113,000 to $188,400\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.



Thomas, a Xometry company, is the leading platform for industrial sourcing and digital marketing. We help manufacturers grow their businesses through high\-impact digital advertising, SEO, and content marketing services. This role is critical to maintaining the data integrity and lead flow that keeps our Sales and Marketing engines running at scale.  

  

We're looking for a seasoned analytics leader to serve as a strategic partner to Sales leadership and the broader executive team, turning complex, ambiguous data into the insight that drives revenue decisions. In this role, you'll own the Sales analytics function end\-to\-end — architecting the dashboard and data ecosystem, building the quota and forecasting models the business runs on, and setting the standards other analysts follow. You'll operate with significant autonomy, work directly with VP\- and C\-level stakeholders, and be trusted to define what "the right metric" even is when the business question is still fuzzy. This is a high\-visibility, high\-ownership role for someone who pairs deep technical fluency with sharp business judgment and the gravitas to influence senior decision\-makers.

  

### **How You'll Contribute:**


* Act as the primary analytics partner to Sales leadership and senior executives — proactively defining key metrics, surfacing strategic insights, and shaping decisions on quota, territory, headcount, and pipeline strategy
* Independently translate ambiguous, open\-ended business questions into structured analyses; identify the right question to ask when leadership hasn't fully defined it themselves
* Own the architecture, roadmap, and governance of Sales dashboards and reporting infrastructure — not just maintenance, but decisions on what gets built, deprecated, or redesigned as the business scales
* Design and continuously refine sales performance and quota models, incorporating historical trends, pipeline data, seasonality, and rep\-level variance to drive quota setting, attainment tracking, and revenue forecasting at the leadership and board level
* Build and evolve forecasting methodology, bringing statistical rigor (trend analysis, cohort analysis, scenario/sensitivity modeling) to what has historically been a more manual or gut\-driven process
* Set reporting standards and analytic best practices across the Sales analytics function; review and improve the work of other analysts, and mentor junior team members on technique, tooling, and stakeholder management
* Proactively identify risks, anomalies, and opportunities in the data — surfacing them to leadership before they're asked for, not just answering the questions in front of you
* Serve as the escalation point and liaison across Product, Marketing, Data Engineering, and Finance to resolve data discrepancies, align on definitions, and ensure a single source of truth across systems
* Lead or significantly contribute to cross\-functional data cleansing and data quality initiatives, including diagnosing root causes upstream in the CRM and data pipeline
* Represent analytics in planning cycles (annual quota setting, territory design, comp plan discussions), advising on trade\-offs with data\-backed recommendations

### **What You'll Bring to Xometry:**


* 5\+ years of experience in Sales/Revenue Operations, Business Analytics, or a related analytics function, with a strong focus on sales analytics, forecasting, or GTM strategy
* Advanced proficiency in SQL (complex joins, window functions, query optimization) and hands\-on expertise in Looker and LookML, including data modeling and semantic layer design (not Looker Studio)
* Advanced Excel/Sheets skills for modeling — able to build and audit complex, multi\-scenario financial and quota models from scratch
* Deep familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and a strong working knowledge of how sales data flows, breaks, and gets misreported across systems
* Demonstrated track record of advising and influencing senior (VP/C\-level) stakeholders using data — including pushing back constructively when the data tells a different story than leadership expects
* Exceptional storytelling and executive communication skills; able to distill complex, multi\-variable analysis into a clear narrative and recommendation for non\-technical audiences
* Strong statistical literacy — trend analysis, forecasting methods, and cohort analysis — with the judgment to know which technique fits which business question
* Proven ability to independently source, assess, and prioritize data and competing asks in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment with shifting requirements

jobs.title: Project Manager Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**Long Description**
--------------------


**CONTEXTE**


Le Project Manager Infrastructure intervient dans un environnement industriel multisites, au sein d’une organisation matricielle. Il contribue à la coordination et à la livraison de projets d’infrastructure en interaction avec plusieurs équipes internes et externes. Le rôle exige une compréhension des pratiques du domaine, une capacité à structurer l’activité et une autonomie importante pour garantir l’avancement, la qualité et la cohérence des projets


**VOTRE RÔLE**


Piloter la coordination et l’exécution des projets : définir les objectifs, planifier les actions, attribuer les responsabilités, suivre l’avancement, analyser les écarts et préparer les rapports destinés au management. Le PM Infra assure la bonne circulation de l’information, anticipe les risques, dirige le travail des contributeurs projet et veille à la performance globale des livrables.


**RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES**


* Structurer périmètre, livrables, risques et planning.
* Coordonner les activités projet et superviser l’exécution.
* Synthétiser l’avancement et préparer les rapports de statut.
* Maintenir des interactions efficaces avec les parties prenantes.
* Contribuer, selon l’expérience, aux activités commerciales locales (représentation, création de demande, services clients).
* Analyses de données, suivi terrain et activités opérationnelles.

**COMPÉTENCES \& PROFIL**


* Master Ingénieur
* Min 10\-15 ans d’expérience.
* Compréhension solide des concepts et pratiques du domaine (projets, infrastructure).
* Capacité à planifier, coordonner, structurer et suivre des actions complexes.
* Forte autonomie, sens du jugement et aptitude à gérer des tâches variées.
* Créativité, adaptabilité et capacité à prendre des initiatives.
* Français courant
* Anglais courant (min B2\)

**QUELQUES RAISONS DE NOUS REJOINDRE**


* **Expertise de pointe**: travaillez sur des projets stratégiques aux côtés des plus grands innovateurs mondiaux, autour de technologies comme les énergies du futur, les biotechnologies, l’intelligence artificielle, ou encore les systèmes embarqués pour les véhicules autonomes.
* **Formation continue** : accédez à des contenus adaptés à votre rôle et à votre discipline, pour vous former en continu sur les dernières technologies. Grâce à notre Engineering Academy et nos campus digitaux, vous pouvez obtenir des certifications techniques ou industries reconnues mondialement.
* **Innovation à impact** : participez à des challenges comme Tech4PositiveFutures ou Future of X, qui financent des projets technologiques à fort impact sociétal et environnemental.
* **Réseau et inclusion** : rejoignez un environnement inclusif avec des réseaux comme Women in Engineering, favorisant l’échange entre pairs et la progression de carrière.
Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22\.1 billion.
  

Make it real \| www.capgemini.com

jobs.title: Epic Implementation Manager (Revenue Cycle)
jobs.description:
Overview:

Lead Enterprise Epic Implementations Across a National Health System


Prime Healthcare is an award\-winning health system headquartered in Ontario, California. Prime Healthcare operates 55 hospitals and has more than 360 outpatient locations in 15 states providing more than 3\.0million patient visits annually. It is one of the nation’s leading health systems with over 60,000 employees and physicians. Twenty\-one of the Prime Healthcare hospitals are members of the Prime Healthcare Foundation, a 501(c)(3\) not\-for\-profit public charity. Prime Healthcare is actively seeking new members to join our corporate team!


Are you an experienced Epic leader who has successfully driven full\-cycle implementations across complex hospital environments?


Prime Healthcare is seeking an experienced Epic Implementation Manager (Clinical) to lead enterprise\-wide deployments across our national health system. You will drive end\-to\-end clinical application implementations, partner closely with clinical and executive leadership, and ensure successful adoption across complex care environments. This is a high\-impact leadership role where your expertise shapes how care is delivered across dozens of hospitals.


What makes this role compelling:

* Lead enterprise\-wide clinical Epic implementations across 50\+ hospitals
* Influence provider workflows, patient care, and clinical outcomes

Own delivery across full lifecycle: design build* go\-live
* Lead and mentor large high\-performing analyst teams
* Partner directly with CMOs, Nursing Leadership, and Executives


Responsibilities:

Under the direction of the Epic Program Manager, the Epic Implementation Manager oversees Revenue Cycle applications, and is responsible for managing all aspects of future Epic implementations at Prime hospitals. The Implementation Manager will build relationships with hospital leadership to ensure corporate and local initiatives are incorporated into future implementations. After each go\-live, the Implementation Manager will oversee a comprehensive handoff to the Production Support team, ensuring a successful transition of support for the hospital. The Implementation Manager will supervise performance of all analysts on their team, which is comprised of the applications in their domain Revenue Cycle.


In this role, you will serve as the driving force behind enterprise Revenue Cycle Epic implementations, leading hospitals through each phase of the journey; from early planning and workflow design to go\-live and stabilization. As a leader, you’ll not only deliver successful implementations, but also mentor and develop your team while building strong, lasting partnerships across the organization.


On any given day, you’ll collaborate with clinical and executive leaders to align system design with real\-world care delivery, guide your team through build and testing milestones, and proactively navigate challenges to keep implementations on track. You’ll be at the center of the action during go\-live, ensuring teams are supported, workflows function as intended, and clinicians are set up for success.


What You’ll Do:

* Lead end\-to\-end Clinical Epic implementations
* Oversee design, build, testing, training, go\-live, and stabilization
* Partner with clinical stakeholders to align workflows and system design
* Ensure adoption of best\-practice clinical workflows
* Lead, coach, and manage clinical application analyst teams
* Drive milestone execution, risk mitigation, and delivery outcomes
* Oversee post\-go\-live transition to support teams
* Travel Requirement: This is a remote role that requires frequent travel (up to 50–75% annually) to hospital sites across the U.S., notably during key implementation phases.


Travel Requirement: This is a remote role that requires frequent travel (up to 50–75% annually) to hospital sites across the U.S., notably during key implementation phases.  

\#LI\-BB1 \#remote
Qualifications:
* Six (6\) or more years of applicable work experience required.
* Minimum five (5\) years of experience working with electronic medical record required.
* Experience leading an Epic implementation required.
* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Management, Computer Science, or related field preferred.
* Minimum four (4\) years of experience with an integrated healthcare information system preferred.
* Minimum four (4\) years of experience in project management preferred.
* Knowledge of healthcare industry and hospital operations preferred.
* Experience leading large teams.
* Strong communication and organizational skills


\#LI\-SM6
Pay Transparency:

Prime Healthcare offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package that provides employees the flexibility to tailor benefits according to their individual needs. Our Total Rewards package includes, but is not limited to, paid time off, a 401K retirement plan, medical, dental, and vision coverage, tuition reimbursement, and many more voluntary benefit options. Benefits may vary based on employment status, i.e. full\-time, part\-time, per diem or temporary. A reasonable compensation estimate for this role, which includes estimated wages, benefits, and other forms of compensation, is $90,875\.20 to $158,662\.40 on an annualized basis. The exact starting compensation to be offered will be determined at the time of selecting an applicant for hire, in which a wide range of factors will be considered, including but not limited to, skillset, years of applicable experience, education, credentials and licensure.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Support Services (ISS) Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


The Office of Information Technology is seeking an IT Specialist (INFOSEC) (Infrastructure Support Services (ISS) Program Manager). In this role, you will lead one of SEC's largest contracts providing customer support, endpoint management, and network \& infrastructure operations to drive strategy, delivery, security, and contractor oversight. You will be serving as the primary COR responsible for managing roadmaps, budgets, requirements, resolving incidents and audits, and reporting outcomes.


Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**
-----------------------


### **The public**


U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
### **Clarification from the agency**


All US Citizens


  
**Duties**
----------


In this role as an Infrastructure Services Support (ISS) Program Manager, you will be responsible for:


* Leading the ISS program across service desk, end\-user tech, AV/VTC, network, M365, infrastructure/cloud, storage, IAM, and asset management.
* Setting program vision, goals, and multiyear roadmap; maintaining the Program Management Plan, integrated schedule, and performance indicators.
* Prioritizing service delivery; managing schedules, risks, issues, and dependencies; resolving competing demands using performance data.
* Driving integrated program reviews, post\-incident remediation, and audit/OIG coordination; reporting program health to leadership.
* Identifying and validating mission needs; mapping proposals to architecture, security, funding, and expected outcomes.
* Developing acquisition\-ready requirements and artifacts (PWS, QASP, IGCE, evaluation criteria, options/mods, acceptance criteria).
* Coordinating with stakeholders to analyze alternatives and lifecycle impacts; maintaining requirements traceability and backlog prioritization.
* Serving as COR under CO designation; executing the QASP; monitoring contractor performance against PWS, SLAs, milestones, and staffing.
* Inspecting and accepting/rejecting deliverables; reviewing invoices; tracking burn rates, ceilings, and risks; maintaining an audit\-ready COR file.
* Integrating security and privacy into planning and operations; coordinating incident response and FISMA/NIST/SEC assessments.

  
**Requirements**
----------------


### **Conditions of employment**


* CITZENSHIP: You must be a US Citizen.
* SELECTIVE SERVICE: Males born after 12/31/59 must be registered or exempt from Selective Service (see https://www.sss.gov/).
* SECURITY CLEARANCE: Entrance on duty is contingent upon completion of a pre\-employment security investigation. Favorable results on a Background Investigation may be a condition of employment or selection to another position.
* PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS): Moving/Relocation expenses are not authorized.
* DIRECT DEPOSIT: All Federal employees are required to have Federal salary payments made by direct deposit to a financial institution of their choosing.
* PROBATIONARY PERIOD: This appointment may require completion of a one\-year probationary period.
* The selectee is required to report to the duty station(s) listed.
* The duties of this position may require the incumbent to carry a cell phone and be on call 24 hours a day, seven days a week on a rotational basis, based on the needs of the organization.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world's most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production\-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.



Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

**Purpose**
-----------



Machine Development operates at the intersection of complex hardware, software, manufacturing, and operations, where successful execution depends on many teams moving together against shared technical and business outcomes. The Staff Technical Program Manager exists to create the clarity, structure, and operating discipline needed to make that happen.



This role drives the integrated execution of Machine Development programs by translating complex and often ambiguous objectives into clear plans, priorities, ownership, milestones, and decisions. The Staff TPM connects work across functions, ensures risks and issues are surfaced and resolved early, and gives teams and leaders the visibility needed to understand performance and make informed tradeoffs.



Success in this role means Machine Development executes more predictably, problems are identified and closed faster, cross\-functional teams stay aligned, and the processes and operating systems supporting execution become increasingly scalable and effective over time.


**The Role**
------------


* Own integrated program schedules, roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, risks, and high\-level development \& execution plans.
* Identify and actively manage program risks, issues, blockers, and dependencies.
* Build and continuously improve scalable business processes, operating cadences, tools, and program controls.
* Drive cross\-functional execution including triage and coordination such as change requests.
* Drive action\-item ownership, escalation, decision\-making, and closure.
* Enable successful change and configuration management.
* Provide clear program status, performance, tradeoffs, and recovery plans to stakeholders and leadership.
* Support coordination of technical and operational readiness for major releases, builds, qualifications, and deployments.
* Lead ad hoc, high\-priority initiatives that require additional structure, coordination, or cross\-functional execution.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------


* Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls
* Bachelor's degree in engineering or related technical field.
* 6\+ years of technical program, engineering, manufacturing, or product development experience.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross\-functional technical programs.
* Strong program planning, scheduling, risk management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to translate ambiguous technical problems into clear plans, owners, milestones, and decisions.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication with technical teams and senior leadership.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced hardware development and manufacturing environment.
* Ability to work additional hours as required by the business.
* Ability to spend time in laboratory, manufacturing, and production environments as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience with complex capital equipment, industrial automation, additive manufacturing, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing.
* Experience managing reliability, qualification, commissioning, or production\-readiness programs.
* Experience with engineering change control, RCCA, configuration management, and product lifecycle processes.
* Working knowledge of Jira, PLM, ERP, MES, requirements management, and program\-management tools.
* Demonstrated ability to establish new processes and operating systems in rapidly evolving organizations.

**Work Environment**
--------------------


* Onsite

**What We Offer:**


* **Holistic Compensation Package:** Enjoy a world\-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results\-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.
* **Wellness and Time Off:** Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year\-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.
* **Comprehensive Health and Wellness:** Prioritize your well\-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company\-sponsored life insurance and short and long\-term disability coverage for peace of mind.
* **Investment in Growth:** We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.
* **Collaborative and High\-Performing Environment:** Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high\-performing team within a fast\-paced, mission\-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

  

  

***Equal Employment Opportunity***  

*Divergent is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected characteristic. Divergent provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with Disabilities and Protected Veterans

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, ERP Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **About the Job**



We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to own program delivery across our ERP/Oracle technology team. This role is accountable for the full lifecycle of ERP initiatives, from initiation through closure ensuring scope, schedules, and stakeholders stay aligned as we move at speed.  

  

The ideal candidate turns complexity into clarity and drives outcomes independently. You identify ambiguity, establish structure, and move initiatives forward without waiting for perfect direction. You don't need to be an ERP developer or technical architect, but you're technically fluent enough to coordinate effectively with functional analysts, developers, integration teams, security teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.  

  

We're moving fast to deliver software that matters. If you thrive in high\-tempo environments and want your work to have real\-world impact, this is the role for you.


### **What You'll Do**


**Program Ownership**


* Own applicable ERP initiatives across the full program lifecycle: initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, delivery, and closure
* Manage scope, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and action items with proactive follow\-through and escalation when blockers arise
* Ensure every initiative has clear objectives, an owner, requirements, acceptance criteria, documentation, and completion criteria
* Manage multiple concurrent ERP initiatives with competing priorities


**Cross\-Functional Partnership**


* Work closely with Finance, Accounting, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain ERP teams to translate business priorities into organized, executable technical work
* Coordinate across business process owners, ERP functional teams, technical development teams, integration teams, security/access teams, external vendors, and leadership
* Lead working sessions, status meetings, planning sessions, and decision\-making forums
* Maintain proactive communication with stakeholders, ensuring they have what they need to make decisions


**Work Management and Backlog Ownership**


* Maintain the ERP team's work\-management system and program backlog, ensuring items have accurate priorities, owners, status, timelines, dependencies, supporting documentation, and next steps
* Support backlog hygiene and prioritization, and produce status reports and executive summaries
* Keep current with project documentation and ensure Jira reflects accurate project status
* Interface with vendors on scheduling, deliverables, and contract alignment (non\-budgetary)

### **Required Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of project or program management experience, including meaningful experience supporting ERP systems, enterprise applications, or technical business systems

Relevant experience with an enterprise ERP platform * \- Oracle Fusion experience preferred; experience with another large\-scale platform such as SAP is also relevant
* Understanding of how ERP technology supports Finance, Accounting, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain business functions
* Strong written and verbal communication, including executive\-level status reporting
* Strong organization, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate independently
* Ability to identify ambiguity, establish structure, and drive decisions without waiting for perfect direction
* Hands\-on experience with Jira and Confluence

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* PMP or comparable project/program\-management certification
* Experience in fast\-paced technology, manufacturing, aerospace, or defense environments

  

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. jobs.title: IT Project Manager, IT PMO
jobs.description:
**About Monster Energy:**
-------------------------



Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk takers, the trailblazers, the gamechangers. We're not perfect and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. Our drive is just like our athletes, unrivaled. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become on along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.


**A Day in the Life:**
----------------------



At Monster Energy, we move fast, push limits, and never settle for status quo — and our IT team is no different. We're looking for a Project Manager to join our IT PMO team and be the driving force behind technology projects that keep our business unstoppable. In this role, you'll lead IT projects from kickoff through completion, working closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to keep initiatives on track, on budget, and aligned with company goals. You'll bring structure and clarity to complex projects, helping our teams move forward with focus and confidence. You will operate independently with minimal oversight, driving cross‑functional alignment across business and IT while influencing stakeholders and executives. If you enjoy solving problems, keeping people aligned, and helping technology run smoothly behind the scenes, join us and help fuel what's next.


**The Impact You'll Make:**
---------------------------



* Develop comprehensive project plans, including scope, schedule, budget, resource allocation, and risk management strategies.
* Lead cross\-functional project teams composed of IT staff, business stakeholders, and third\-party vendors through all phases of the project lifecycle — initiation, planning, design/requirements gathering, development (including integration coordination), QA testing, UAT, and closure.
* Serve as the primary liaison between business sponsors, technical teams, and executive leadership, ensuring alignment on objectives, priorities, and expectations.
* Track and report project status, milestones, budget performance, and key metrics using PMO standard tools and templates (e.g., dashboards, RAID logs, status reports).
* Identify, assess, and manage project risks and issues, escalating appropriately and driving resolution in a timely manner
* Manage project scope and change control, evaluating change requests for impact on schedule, cost, and resources.
* Facilitate project meetings, including kickoffs, status updates, steering committee reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensure adherence and adoption of PMO governance standards, methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, hybrid), and documentation requirements.
* Coordinate resource planning and allocation with functional managers to ensure project staffing needs are met.
* Manage vendor, SI, and contractor relationships, including scope adherence, deliverables, and contract compliance.
* Support budget forecasting, tracking, and reconciliation for assigned projects.
* Drive post\-implementation reviews and lessons\-learned sessions following a major release to support continuous improvement of PMO practices.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date project documentation in the PMO's project management system.
* Act as an ambassador for the PMO and project management functions.


**Who You Are:**
----------------



* Bachelor's degree in project management, business administration, information technology, or related field is required. Advanced degree preferred
* 5\+ years of experience managing complex, enterprise\-grade IT projects with multi\-system dependencies. Preference within a formal PMO structure.
* Experience working within IT environments and familiarity with software development lifecycle (SDLC) and enterprise\-grade applications.
* Experience managing Salesforce platform projects, including implementations, enhancements, integrations, data flows, and ongoing application management.
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently with minimal oversight.
* Proven ability to drive cross\-functional alignment across business and IT and influence stakeholders and executives without direct authority.
**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, hybrid approaches)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple, concurrent priorities
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams without direct authority and drive accountability across departments.
* Solid understanding of budgeting, financial tracking, and resource management principles.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive approach to risk identification and mitigation.
* Strong vendor and SI partner management skills specific to Salesforce delivery
* Proficient with Microsoft Suite and project management tools. ClickUp and LucidChart or equivalent preferred.

Hourly rate: **$80/hour.** Benefits are available through Talent Table. **No C2C.**

**Key Deliverables / What You Will Do**

* Act as a trusted partner to Recruiting leadership and cross\-functional teams. Represent the recruiting function in projects, drive process optimization, influence decision\-making, and provide SME\-level guidance on recruiting operations, tools, and workflows.
* Design, manage, and optimize end\-to\-end recruitment workflows, leveraging process improvement methodologies to ensure efficiency, scalability, and alignment with organizational priorities. Drive continuous improvement of our recruiting technology stack by identifying gaps, evaluating processes, and creating impact through partnerships across Talent.
* Lead process improvement initiatives focused on scalability, automation, and simplification. Leverage insights to design streamlined workflows that reduce manual effort and improve quality and consistency across global teams.
* Serve as a liaison between TA, Product, and Engineering teams, employing project management frameworks to drive effective communication, prioritize tasks, and deliver complex cross\-functional initiatives on schedule.
* Leverage recruiting and operational data to identify trends, monitor performance, and develop actionable insights. Drive accountability around metric adoption, reporting integrity, and operational KPIs.
* Support the planning and execution of recruiting programs and technology implementations. Track milestones, ensure cross\-functional alignment, and surface risks and dependencies early.
* Oversee the development and governance of process documentation, training materials, and self\-service knowledge resources. Ensure accessibility, accuracy, and usability across teams.
* Partner closely with the TA Programs team to understand business needs and translate them into clear, actionable design requirements that drive TA initiatives.
* Partner with Talent Data \& Analytics, Security, and Legal to understand the implications of process or tooling decisions, including governance, compliance, and risk assessments.

* Drive cross\-functional initiatives across Talent Acquisition, Talent, Finance, and business leadership, aligning stakeholders and clearing blockers before they escalate.
* Actively participate in post\-mortems to assess project outcomes, identify areas for improvement, and drive enhancements in project management processes and methodologies across global TA.

---------------------------



* Develop comprehensive project plans, including scope, schedule, budget, resource allocation, and risk management strategies.
* Lead cross\-functional project teams composed of IT staff, business stakeholders, and third\-party vendors through all phases of the project lifecycle — initiation, planning, design/requirements gathering, development (including integration coordination), QA testing, UAT, and closure.

* Track and report project status, milestones, budget performance, and key metrics using PMO standard tools and templates (e.g., dashboards, RAID logs, status reports).
* Identify, assess, and manage project risks and issues, escalating appropriately and driving resolution in a timely manner
* Manage project scope and change control, evaluating change requests for impact on schedule, cost, and resources.
* Facilitate project meetings, including kickoffs, status updates, steering committee reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensure adherence and adoption of PMO governance standards, methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, hybrid), and documentation requirements.
* Coordinate resource planning and allocation with functional managers to ensure project staffing needs are met.
* Manage vendor, SI, and contractor relationships, including scope adherence, deliverables, and contract compliance.
* Support budget forecasting, tracking, and reconciliation for assigned projects.
* Drive post\-implementation reviews and lessons\-learned sessions following a major release to support continuous improvement of PMO practices.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date project documentation in the PMO's project management system.
* Act as an ambassador for the PMO and project management functions.


**Who You Are:**

* Bachelor's degree in project management, business administration, information technology, or related field is required. Advanced degree preferred
* 5\+ years of experience managing complex, enterprise\-grade IT projects with multi\-system dependencies. Preference within a formal PMO structure.
* Experience working within IT environments and familiarity with software development lifecycle (SDLC) and enterprise\-grade applications.
* Experience managing Salesforce platform projects, including implementations, enhancements, integrations, data flows, and ongoing application management.
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently with minimal oversight.
* Proven ability to drive cross\-functional alignment across business and IT and influence stakeholders and executives without direct authority.
**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, hybrid approaches)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple, concurrent priorities
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams without direct authority and drive accountability across departments.
* Solid understanding of budgeting, financial tracking, and resource management principles.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive approach to risk identification and mitigation.
* Strong vendor and SI partner management skills specific to Salesforce delivery
* Proficient with Microsoft Suite and project management tools. ClickUp and LucidChart or equivalent preferred.

BU Data Analyst II
jobs.description:
We’re always looking for diverse, talented, service\-oriented people to join our exceptional team.


BU Data Analyst II
The pay range for this position is listed below. Our pay ranges are built to allow for candidates with various levels of skill and experience to be considered, as well as for room for growth and tenure achieved in a role over time. Typical new hire salary offers fall within the minimum to midpoint of a pay range for many candidates. Any offer extended to a candidate will be based upon their unique set of knowledge, skills, education, and experience as well as internal equity.


**Pay Range:**

$97,552\.00 \- $156,083\.00
**Scheduled Weekly Hours:**

40
**What You’ll Be Doing**Under limited supervision, responsible for complex systems administration within the business unit, including design, development, testing, implementation, troubleshooting, administration and enhancement of assigned systems, including workflow design and third party integrations. Acts as a subject matter expert and key liaison among stakeholders based on advanced understanding of the structure, policies, and operation, in order to develop recommendations and solutions to solve problems and issues related to business operations. Maintains advanced knowledge and skillset of business systems in order to effectively bridge the gap between business unit inefficiencies and technology solutions.
* Designated as a subject matter expert and functions as a liaison and point of contact to Information Technology from the line of business, representing the end users and business process owners in business system requirements, implementations and support for software products.
* Maintains a solid understanding of data management, business systems, procedures and processes for the corresponding business unit.
* Consults with management and users to determine the needs and functional requirements of the system, which may include software requirements, technical requirements, system requirements or new technologies \& features that may contribute to business process efficiencies. Defines user system requirements, provides user support and coordinates user acceptance testing of new tools.
* Represents user needs in the development of functional specifications and works closely with IT to design or enhance a system to meet the business goals. Prepares and delivers business users’ system needs and writes technical documents to give other analysts and Information Technology insight into system architecture, business rules, and Integration Services.
* Participates in the overall project planning, which includes, identifying system and process gaps and initiating changes to processes and or systems, including performing feasibility analysis, developing project scope, and providing recommendations on alternative solutions, project strategy and deliverable prioritization.
* Participates in roll out of system and process changes. Participates in implementation, coordinating tests, and observing initiation of the system to validate performance. Works closely with teammembers, developers, testers and a variety of end users to ensure technical compatibility and user satisfaction; ensuring that budgets are adhered to and deadlines met.
* Analyzes and communicates stakeholder needs by translating business requirements into software or reporting requirements. Designs and creates workflows for business processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness, while allowing for better management oversight of processes and enhanced reporting.
* Specifies inputs and formatting outputs to meet users’ needs, using techniques such as sampling, model building and structured analysis to ensure the solution is efficient, cost\-effective and financially feasible.
* May develop specifications, diagrams and flowcharts for programmers to follow.
* Administers software version control for assigned systems and oversees testing and installation of all upgrades, patches, and maintenance updates. Escalate software related issues to 3rd party vendors. Actively participates in design and testing system upgrades or conversions, security reviews and system conversions.
* Effectively manages form libraries, troubleshoots macros, system mappings, and integration documents.
* Applies system maintenance to data files, product descriptions, rates channels, fees channels, and related decision engines to ensure accurate system performance.
* Administers security requirements for assigned systems and participates in security reviews/audits.
* Configures user roles and set\-up of new users; periodically audits active users for security purposes.
* Troubleshoots hardware and/or software issues. Logs system failures, reports bugs to developers, and proactively works with 2nd level support teams (internal and external) for quick resolutions. Availability to support systems and apply upgrades, new or changed products, restoration of system performance after a mishap.
* Provides training and user manuals to users of a new or existing system. Prepares end\-user release notes and procedural documentation to support upgrades.
Keeps up to date with technical and industry developments.  
* 
  

**Additional Job Functions*** + Performs other duties as assignedComplies with regulatory compliance and assigned training requirements including but not limited to BSA regulations corresponding to their specific job duties. jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

A Reporting Data Analyst, you will drive the reporting and analytics behind our sales and operations planning (S\&OP) process for our portfolio of Adventure Sports brands, delivering insights across demand, supply, and inventory — leveraging AI tools embedded throughout how we analyze data and report on it.


You will partner with demand and supply planning, operations, finance, and commercial teams to build dashboards and recurring S\&OP deliverables, consolidating large data sets from disparate, fragmented sources that require cleansing and reconciliation into clear narratives on risks, opportunities, and trends. AI fluency is a core requirement: you will be expected to actively use and continuously expand your use of AI tools across the reporting workflow.


This position reports to the Director of S\&OP and is based out of our Irvine, CA office.


As the **S\&OP Data** **Analyst,** you will have an opportunity to:


**S\&OP Reporting \& Cadence**

* Support the monthly and weekly S\&OP reporting cycle across demand, supply, inventory, and executive review meetings.
* Build, maintain, and distribute recurring reports and dashboards that summarize plan vs. actual performance, forecast accuracy, and key supply chain KPIs.
* Prepare clear, executive\-ready PowerPoint summaries and pre\-reads that highlight trends, risks, and recommended actions.
* Maintain reporting calendars, trackers, and QA checklists to ensure on\-time, accurate deliverables.
* Use AI tools to draft executive narratives, summarize variances, and accelerate the production of recurring S\&OP deliverables.

**Demand, Supply \& Inventory Analytics**

* Develop analyses that improve visibility into demand signals, supply plans, inventory positions, and service levels.
* Track forecast accuracy, bias, MAPE, and other planning KPIs across categories, channels, and SKUs.
* Monitor inventory health metrics including weeks of supply, excess and obsolete risk, and stockout exposure.
* Partner with planning and operations to run root\-cause analysis on plan deviations, surface early warnings, and quantify business impact.
* Apply AI\-assisted analysis to detect anomalies, explain drivers of forecast and inventory variance, and generate plain\-language insights from large data sets.

**Dashboards, Tools \& Data**

* Design and maintain Power BI dashboards and self\-service reporting for supply chain and S\&OP stakeholders.
* Leverage Microsoft Copilot and other AI tools to accelerate analysis, summarization, and reporting workflows.
* Partner with IT and data teams to validate source data, improve data quality, and document reporting logic.
* Consolidate, scrub, standardize, and reconcile data from ERP, planning, finance, commercial, and external partner systems into a trusted reporting view.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and reduce cycle time on recurring deliverables, with a strong bias toward AI\-driven automation.

**Insights \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Translate data into clear insights and recommendations that inform S\&OP decisions and operational priorities.
* Partner with finance to reconcile operational performance to financial outcomes and forecasts.
* Support ad hoc analyses for leadership, including scenario modeling and business case support.
* Document standard definitions and reporting playbooks to drive consistency.
* Champion AI adoption across the supply chain and S\&OP function — share prompts, workflows, and use cases that help peers work faster and smarter.

**You have:**

* 3–5 years of experience in business analytics and reporting roles, supply chain or operations analyst
* Hands\-on experience supporting recurring reporting cycles in a manufacturing or consumer products environment.
* Strong understanding of S\&OP processes, demand and supply planning concepts, and core supply chain KPIs.
* Bachelor's degree in supply chain, operations, business, analytics, finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proficiency in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, and dashboard design (required).
* Familiarity with ERP and planning systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis, or similar).
* Working knowledge of forecast accuracy, inventory, and service\-level KPIs.
* Thrives in dynamic environments where data is fragmented across disparate systems and routinely needs to be scrubbed and reconciled before analysis, with the ability to translate findings into clear recommendations.
* Enthusiasm for AI and experience using Microsoft Copilot or similar tools to enhance reporting and analytics productivity, with a willingness to keep expanding that skill set.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

We’re looking for a global transformation leader who can align markets around common operating standards and lead measurable improvements in repair quality, efficiency, and compliance. This pivotal role brings together continuous improvement, tooling, training, data, and cross\-functional execution to build repeatable systems and help teams deliver consistent results at scale.


You will lead a globally diverse team of project managers in turning complex operational problems into scalable solutions—from diagnosing root causes and testing changes in live operations to validating impact and translating proven practices into global standards. You will partner closely with Local Operations, Central Operations, Supply Chain, Product, Engineering, Data, and Finance to build alignment, drive adoption, and embed sustainable change across markets.

Join our global community of over **190,000 dedicated employees** around the world in driving the transformation of the eyewear and eyecare industry.


Discover more by following us on LinkedIn!

  

  

**Your \#FutureInSight with EssilorLuxottica**


Are you willing to pioneer new frontiers, foster inclusivity and collaboration, embrace agility, ignite passion, and make a positive impact on the world? Join us in redefining the boundaries of what’s possible!  



**About the role :**


The IT Security Specialist plays a key role in safeguarding the organization’s EMEA retail IT landscape. The position covers Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC) activities within the BeNe Optical retail organization and Security Operations across the EMEA retail environment.

  

The role is embedded within the Global Security Operations Center (SOC) Level 2 team 3 working days per week, with a strong focus on security monitoring, incident detection, investigation, and response, leveraging modern SIEM and XDR technologies. 2 working days per week, the role is reserved for BeNe Optical retail for GRC Governance and Local security oversight.

  

**What you will do :**

  

**1\. Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC) and Operational Support. (BeNe Optical Retail Scope) :**


* Register, monitor, and report on objectives and activities within IT Security processes in collaboration with Benelux business and IT stakeholders.


* Maintain, configure, and continuously improve the Information Security Management System (ISMS) within GRC tooling.


* Register, track, and report security incidents within GRC tooling.


* Provide advice to the Benelux Retail Information Security Officer on information security measures.


* Support vulnerability management with a primary focus on operational remediation coordination and prioritization.


* Act as an information security advisor for new IT solutions and major changes to the IT Benelux infrastructure.

  

**2\. Security Operations (EMEA Optical Retail Scope) :**


* Operate as an embedded analyst within the Global SOC Level 2 team, supporting EMEA retail operations.


* Monitor, triage, investigate, and respond to security alerts and incidents, ensuring timely detection, containment, remediation, and escalation.


* Manage and investigate security alerts partially escalated by an external Level 1 (L1\) SOC via a ticketing system, while handling other alerts directly within the XDR platform.


* Utilize and optimize XDR platforms, including Microsoft Defender and Palo Alto Cortex, to enhance threat detection and response.


* Correlate events across endpoints, identities, networks, and cloud environments to identify advanced and persistent threats.


* Support the deployment, onboarding, and troubleshooting of XDR solutions, including endpoints, identities, networks, and cloud workloads.

  

**3\. Reporting \& Stakeholder Management :**


* Provide regular and ad\-hoc reporting to the Global IT Security Operations Manager and the Bene Optical Retail Information Security Officer.


* Act as a liaison between Global Security Operations and the Benelux retail organization, ensuring alignment between global operations and local governance requirements.


* Participate in IT security–related meetings and stakeholder consultations.

  

**What sets you apart :**

  

* Proven experience in Security Operations (SOC), preferably at Level 2\.


* Demonstrated expertise in XDR solutions, such as Microsoft Defender and Palo Alto Cortex.


* Experience with security incident detection, investigation, and response across endpoint, identity, network, and cloud environments.


* Solid understanding of common attack techniques, threat vectors, and incident response methodologies.


* Experience working in international or distributed environments, preferably within retail or large enterprise organizations.


* Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


* Experience in Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC) processes, including audits, ISMS management, and policy implementation.


* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

  

**Preferred Qualifications :**

  

* Knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST, or similar information security frameworks.


* Experience with vulnerability remediation coordination in enterprise environments.


* Dutch language proficiency (spoken and written) is preferred.


* Relevant certifications such as GCIH, GCED, SC\-200, AZ\-500, or Palo Alto certifications are a plus.

  

Recruitment process : 3 interviews \- Our recruitment process may vary; If you are selected, you will be contacted by our recruiters to guide you through the specific steps for your application.

jobs.description:

**Mission générale**
--------------------


Au sein de la Direction Data \& Expérience Client, le/la Business Analyst est garant(e) de la production, de la fiabilité et de la valorisation des données au service du pilotage de l'activité. Il/elle conçoit des outils d'aide à la décision (tableaux de bord, indicateurs, études) à destination des équipes métiers, en France comme à l'international, et contribue directement aux enjeux de performance commerciale et de maîtrise des coûts du Groupe.


**Détails de l’offre**
----------------------


* Concevoir, développer et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord de pilotage sous Power BI


* Recueillir les besoins auprès des équipes métiers (commerce, marketing, finance, opérations) et les traduire en indicateurs et solutions data exploitables


* Réaliser des analyses de données permettant d'identifier les leviers d'action prioritaires et les axes d'amélioration pour les équipes métiers.


* Assurer un pilotage dans la durée des indicateurs clés (KPI), en suivant les écarts et en alertant les équipes métiers en cas de dérive


* Prendre en charge l'analyse des résultats d'enquêtes (volet Analytics), incluant l'automatisation des traitements et la systématisation de la diffusion des résultats aux responsables de secteur.


* Travailler en mode transverse avec des référents métiers en France et à l'international afin de comprendre leurs besoins et d'y répondre par des livrables adaptés à l'échelle Groupe.

------------------------


* Formation Bac\+4/5 (école de commerce, d'ingénieur ou université) avec une spécialisation Data / Business Analytics.

* Maîtrise avancée de Power BI (modélisation de données, DAX, création de dashboards et administration)
