Elior, filiale d'Elior Group, est n°1 en restauration collective en France. Depuis plus de 25 ans, nous anticipons les évolutions de notre métier, en devançant les attentes et les besoins des enfants, élèves, étudiants, travailleurs, patients et résidents…



Rejoindre Elior France, c'est rejoindre 17 000 collaborateurs engagés sur l'un de nos 100 métiers, qu'il s'agisse de fonctions opérationnelles ou de fonctions support. Nos 3 500 restaurants sont répartis sur toute la France.  

Faire partie de nos équipes fonction support, c'est apporter votre soutien aux équipes opérationnelles pour les aider à satisfaire quotidiennement nos clients et convives. C'est également l'opportunité d'intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution qui vous permettra d'enrichir votre expertise et vos compétences.



Comme nous, venez exprimer votre passion de la cuisine et du service, et évoluer dans un Groupe qui favorise la réussite par le collectif et le collaboratif.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
In the journey of life, your career should make a difference.


At Inizio Evoke, we come together—to do the best work, in the best possible place. We're all in. Because it's everyone's role to make health more human™.


**About the Role**


We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the operating rhythm of Operatev — Inizio Evoke's enterprise AI platform — from the inside out.


This is a high\-visibility, cross\-functional role responsible for keeping the program on schedule and its status transparent. You'll own the connective tissue: sequencing work across Product, Development, Change \& Enablement, Support, Operations, Business Transformation, and Commercialization so that nothing blocks on an unowned handoff and everyone is working from the same picture of where things stand.


You will sit at the center of a program that is building and rolling out a platform to 1,200 people. That means competing priorities, real dependencies, and a delivery pace that doesn't slow down. You will bring strong program management fundamentals in a product development environment, thrive on clarity and structure, and know how to translate complex cross\-functional realities into reporting that actually drives decisions.


This is a remote role reporting to the Program Lead.

  



**What You'll Do:**


***Own Cross\-Team Sequencing***


* Map dependencies across functions — what depends on what, in what order — and monitor progress against that sequence
* Ensure handoffs are owned, surface unresolved blockers early, and drive items to closure or escalation
* Maintain visibility into the implications of sequencing decisions for Product, Development, and all downstream functions

***Run the Quarterly Planning Cycle***


* Gather functional inputs across all workstreams
* Facilitate commitment\-setting and document outcomes
* Translate quarterly commitments into trackable milestones and hold functions accountable to them

***Track Program Resourcing***


* Maintain visibility into where capacity is going against what's committed and manage the program's calendar to proactively address capacity challenges
* Surface trends and anomalies to program leadership before they become problems
* Oversee recruitment process, meeting with talent acquisition for updates and ensuring timely progress through stakeholder participation

***Set and Hold Stage Gate Standards***


* Define the gates work passes through and what evidence clears each one
* Keep functional cadences in sync without taking over internal functional processes (sprint practices, capability lifecycle, etc.)

***Run Delivery Forums***


* Facilitate the weekly initiative update and risk review
* Maintain the risk register and drive items to resolution or escalation
* Track progress against quarterly commitments and hold the reporting cadence

***Define Reporting Standards***


* Establish and maintain the data taxonomy that governs how each function reports its metrics
* Ensure functional outputs roll into one consistent program\-level picture rather than competing narratives

***Own Executive Reporting***


* Prepare and deliver the synthesized program view for executive and steering committee audiences
* Surface where delivery reality constrains what's being asked — clearly and with context

  

**What You'll Bring:**


* 7\+ years of experience in program management, delivery management, or PMO leadership — ideally within a technology platform, transformation, or product delivery context
* Experience running formal planning cycles (quarterly or release\-based) and translating outputs into trackable commitments
* Track record of building and maintaining executive\-level reporting that is trusted and acted on
* Comfortable managing budget and resource visibility — not ownership, but accurate tracking and surfacing of variance
* Background in professional services, agency, consulting, or regulated industry preferred (healthcare, life sciences, or similar)

***Skills***


* Strong program and project management fundamentals — dependency mapping, risk management, stage gates, and cadence management
* Highly organized: you make things visible, structured, and easy to act on
* Strong written and verbal communication; able to translate complexity into clean reporting without losing accuracy
* Comfortable operating in agile/iterative environments where priorities shift and the plan evolves
* Skilled facilitator — able to run productive cross\-functional forums without letting them drift

***Mindset***


* You keep things moving without needing to own everything
* You surface problems early and bring them forward with enough context for a decision
* You enforce standards consistently — not rigidly, but reliably
* You understand the difference between tracking and deciding, and you stay in your lane while making it easy for others to stay in theirs

  

**What We Offer**


* A central, high\-impact role in a program building something genuinely new — an enterprise AI platform designed to change how a 1,200\-person agency does its work
* Direct visibility to executive and steering committee leadership
* A cross\-functional operating environment where your work touches every part of the program
* The opportunity to define and own the operating standards that the program runs on

Inizio Evoke provides an exciting and flexible work environment, great compensation packages and outstanding company paid benefits including medical, dental, 401(k), tuition reimbursement and flexible time off.

Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub) is built around a simple purpose: to clear the way to help people turn intention into action, and action into financial progress. That means offering focused products, a frictionless mobile\-first experience, and clear terms with no gotchas. Respect and fairness is part of our DNA, and that ideal shapes how we work, how we treat each other, and how we invest in our employees and our community. * Use creativity, analytical expertise, and sound judgment to identify and mitigate risk
* Use AI tools fluently and stay current on new AI use cases, methods and bring them into your work thoughtfully
* Assist in preparing periodic reporting materials for executive leadership
* Assist in regulatory exam readiness and internal audit reviews

Local hours (PT, MT, ET)

As needed travel to Happen Bank offices and/or other locations, as needed.

The target base salary range for this position is 81,000\-125,000\. The base salary of the role will be determined by job\-related knowledge, experience, education, skills, and location. jobs.title: IT Sr. Project Manager, Helen Diller Hospital
jobs.description:
The Senior IT Project Manager will lead planning, coordination, and execution of IT workstreams supporting the Helen Diller Hospital project, a multi\-year, large\-scale capital initiative. This role will oversee technology program delivery across clinical applications, infrastructure, and end\-user systems to ensure alignment with hospital operational readiness and strategic goals. Responsibilities include managing scope, schedule, budget, risks, and dependencies across diverse stakeholder groups; facilitating decision\-making between IT, construction, and clinical leadership; and ensuring regulatory, security, and patient safety requirements are met. The Senior IT Project Manager will serve as a primary liaison between IT leadership, project governance, and vendor partners, providing executive\-level visibility into progress, issues, and mitigation strategies.


As a Senior IT Project Manager for the Helen Diller Hospital project, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of healthcare delivery. This position is responsible for planning and implementing fully integrated IT solutions to support the new Helen Diller Hospital at Parnassus Heights. The work involves implementing IT services that are future\-ready, adaptable to emerging technologies, and capable of supporting smooth transitions over time.  



This role requires a deep understanding of institutional, medical center, and systemwide priorities, as well as long\-term strategic goals. You will lead and manage complex IT workstreams with broad institutional impact, requiring sophisticated analysis, cross\-functional collaboration, and innovative problem\-solving.  



As a recognized subject matter expert and senior leader in project management, you will influence methods, standards, and best practices across the organization. Your expertise will not only guide the Helen Diller Hospital initiative but will also shape how large\-scale IT projects are managed across the campus, medical center, and broader UC system.  



The new 15\-story, 875,000 gross\-square\-foot (GSF) hospital will enable UCSF to provide much\-needed capacity for additional acute, emergency and intensive care beds, meet the state’s seismic requirements, and provide an optimal healing environment that addresses social, psychological, spiritual, and behavioral components of health in one place. The holistic focus on the needs of patients reflects UCSF’s integrated research, education and care delivery mission at Parnassus Heights. The new hospital will incorporate the latest innovations in technology and equipment for advanced complex care and bridge scientific research discoveries from bench to bedside leading to accelerated innovative treatments and therapies to benefit patients.  



UCSF Health is a growing regional health system that includes UCSF Medical Center, the top\-ranked hospital in California and among the top five nationally, according to U.S. News \& World Report. The new hospital will be embedded within a campus that includes leading clinicians and scientists focused on translating discoveries into treatments and cures. UCSF Helen Diller Medical Center is part of a planned broader revitalization of the Parnassus Heights campus that also will modernize facilities supporting our research and education priorities.  



As a key member of the multi\-disciplinary UCSF Health IT team, you will be at the front line of creating the next generation of healthcare delivery. It involves a deep understanding of health care business capabilities, planned stakeholder experiences and journeys, technology, and proven project management methodologies.  



To ensure a successful opening, the UCSF HDH IT Working Committee will define and prioritize opportunities to test new technologies and workflows that can be deployed earlier in existing hospitals. Through this continuous learning approach, you will help prepare our frontline staff and operations, and design for patients and families a seamless care experience between UCSF Health and partner care facilities, as well as pre\- and post\-procedure at home.  



**Department Overview**

UCSF Health IT is responsible for all aspects of clinical and business software applications, informatics, and AI for UCSF Health hospitals, practices, affiliates, and community partners. This includes the Electronic Health Record (APeX), which supports the clinical, revenue cycle, and clinical operational functions of the health system and its affiliates, and approximately 95 other software applications involved in patient care and operations.

**Judgment:** Makes wise decisions, identifies root causes, thinks strategically, and prioritizes what to do now and what can be improved later.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Client Delivery
jobs.description:
**Vivodyne creates human data before clinical trials.**
-------------------------------------------------------



We accelerate the successful discovery, design, and development of human therapeutics by testing on large, lab\-grown human organ tissues at massive scale, driving technological advancement at the convergence of novel biology, robotics, and AI. We identify and validate new therapeutic targets and de\-risk new therapeutic assets by producing clinically translatable multi\-omic data from our proprietary, physiologically\-realistic human organ tissues at unprecedented scale, speed, and quality. This enables us to produce more human data than all clinical trials in the U.S. combined. We’re financially backed by some of the most selective and successful venture funds, and we have already partnered with a majority of the top 10 multinational pharmaceutical companies to discover and develop better, safer drugs and dramatically reduce the burden of animal testing.



www.vivodyne.com


**Role**
--------



Vivodyne is seeking a **Senior Program Manager, Client Delivery** to lead the operational delivery of complex client programs across Vivodyne’s scientific, technical, and commercial teams. This person will serve as a primary internal coordinator and, for assigned accounts, a client\-facing program lead. They will translate work plans into executable schedules, maintain clear communication, surface risks early, and ensure delivery commitments remain visible across teams.



This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in San Francisco, working closely with a bicoastal delivery team, with occasional travel to our Philadelphia site.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


#### **Client Engagement \& Delivery**


* **Own end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of complex client programs**, accountable for delivering against agreed scope, timelines, budget, and client commitments from kickoff and work\-plan alignment through execution, data delivery, closeout, and subsequent phases. Programs may span multiple technical workstreams, sites, external partners, and extended timelines.
* **Act as a consistent client\-facing program lead** for assigned accounts, establishing communication cadence, coordinating key decisions and follow\-ups, providing clear status updates, and raising schedule or deliverable risks early.
* **Lead client kickoff and delivery planning**, ensuring work plans, dependencies, ownership, collaboration workflows, and legal or operational prerequisites are aligned before execution.
* **Coordinate data and documentation delivery**, establishing clear expectations, ownership, and timelines for technical reports, assay and methods documentation, data packages, presentations, and client communications.

#### **Internal Stakeholder Alignment \& Resource Management**


* **Build and maintain integrated program plans** covering milestones, dependencies, study schedules, resources, owners, risks, and delivery dates, providing practical execution guidance when programs compete for shared resources.
* **Coordinate cross\-functional execution** across biology, operations, microfabrication, hardware/software, data analysis, business development, and leadership. Translate program objectives and requirements into clear internal context, decisions, and next steps.
* **Manage scope, capacity, and schedule trade\-offs**, identifying constraints across resource availability, product readiness, staffing, materials, technical development, client requirements, and operational capacity; facilitate decisions and communicate their implications.
* **Run portfolio\-level delivery operating rhythms**, including weekly reviews and leadership updates that surface priorities, risks, decisions, and cross\-team dependencies.
* **Maintain a reliable system for program and portfolio management**, ensuring project plans, ownership, dependencies, risks, and status remain current and visible across teams.

#### **Strategy \& Operational Excellence**


* **Coordinate internal R\&D and tissue roadmap execution** in partnership with biology and product leads, translating scientific priorities into executable plans, milestones, and timelines. Balance internal model and capability development with client delivery commitments.
* **Partner with BD and leadership on feasibility, resourcing, pricing, and delivery planning** for prospective and expanding client work, helping evaluate scope alternatives, timelines, cost inputs, and operational feasibility.
* **Improve delivery processes and knowledge transfer** by documenting repeatable workflows, clarifying ownership, creating training materials, and ensuring critical program and account knowledge is transferable across the team.
* **Lead and champion program management best practices**, creating consistent ways of working across teams for planning, execution, risk management, communication, and delivery

### **What success looks like**


* Client programs are delivered against agreed scope, timelines, budget, and client commitments, with deviations proactively managed and communicated.
* Clients have a clear, reliable view of milestones, deliverables, owners, and changes.
* Internal teams understand the scientific and commercial context of their work.
* Risks and dependency conflicts are identified and addressed early, with explicit options and decisions.
* Program plans reflect reliable data and actual operational capacity rather than only desired timelines.
* Data, methods, and client\-facing materials are delivered in an organized, predictable way.
* Program knowledge is well\-documented for clean account ownership transfers.
* Client delivery and internal R\&D priorities are effectively balanced and coordinated.

**Requirements and Expectations**
---------------------------------


* 5\+ years of experience leading complex, cross\-functional programs in biotech, pharma, life sciences, CRO/CDMO, healthcare technology, or a similarly technical client\-delivery

jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high\-risk product decisions, often in fast\-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross\-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision\-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross\-functional risk review. The ideal person will have exceptional judgment, strategic foresight, and the ability to operate across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual\-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large\-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject\-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.  

  

  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy\-challenging.
* Coordinate across Legal, Policy, Data Strategy, Engineering, and Product to ensure high\-risk reviews are surfaced and addressed with the appropriate depth and speed
* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress.
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations.
* Facilitate decision\-making through risk\-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed.
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow\-through.
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI\-integrated workflows.
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance.

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust \& safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver high\-pressure, high\-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross\-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority
* Experience building, improving, or operationalizing risk review, escalation, assessment, or governance processes
* Strong judgment in situations involving competing priorities, incomplete information, and significant business, regulatory, safety, privacy, or reputational risk
* Experience using AI/automation to improve complex workflows, analysis, decision\-making, or operational processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with comfort embracing ambiguity and improving systems

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working on privacy, content, legal, or compliance\-related product issues
* Experience with consumer\-facing technology, platforms, AI/ML products, infrastructure, or other technically complex products

Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities
* Experience working with AI agents, automation, or other emerging technologies to improve risk assessment and operational efficiency
* Understanding of regulatory, reputational, or policy risks related to consumer\-facing technology
* Experience developing and driving strategy or roadmap for cross\-functional projects and/or teams
* Background in triaging or adjudicating product\-level risks, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context
* Comfort presenting risk perspectives to senior stakeholders and leading through ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

Cyber Threat Specialists use a variety of commercial and custom tools and processes to provide the information security services mentioned above. **Company Description**

Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real\-world data and AI analytics. Guardant tests help improve outcomes across all stages of care, including screening to find cancer early, monitoring for recurrence in early\-stage cancer, and treatment selection for patients with advanced cancer. For more information, visit guardanthealth.com and follow the company on LinkedIn , X (Twitter) and Facebook .


**Company Description**  

Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company committed to conquering cancer through the use of advanced proprietary tests, vast data sets, and cutting\-edge analytics. Guardant Health's platform supports commercial adoption, reduces healthcare costs, and advances the field of oncology. The company has launched several breakthrough products, including Guardant360®, Guardant Infinity®, and Guardant Reveal™, catering to both early\-stage and advanced cancer patients.  



  

**Job Description**  

We are seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented Technical Program Manager to drive execution across the Data Platform team. You will coordinate projects and programs across cross\-functional initiatives to ensure the successful, on\-time delivery of the programs that power Guardant Health's clinical, genomic, and real\-world data applications. You bring a solid technical foundation and a track record of managing complex, multi\-disciplinary software programs from planning through production release, keeping stakeholders aligned and teams unblocked at every stage.
  

  

**Responsibilities**

* **Project Execution:** Drive projects within complex, multi\-disciplinary programs across the Data Platform. Lead core and sub\-teams, coordinate projects and programs, and keep initiatives aligned to program goals and delivery commitments.
* **Planning \& Scheduling:** Build and maintain project timelines, schedules, and roadmaps. Manage resources and dependencies to ensure predictable and on\-time delivery.
* **SDLC \& Governance** : Adhere to stage\-gate quality and SDLC control guidelines throughout the full systems development life cycle, ensuring deliverables meet quality and compliance standards.
* **Risk \& Change Management:** Proactively identify, track, and resolve issues, risks, and project change requests. Escalate and drive decisions to keep programs on schedule.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Support cross\-functional activities and document management needs across Product, Data Engineering, and business stakeholders. Facilitate agile ceremonies and remove blockers for the team.
* **Communication \& Reporting** : Streamline the delivery of the Data Platform's various AI initiatives, and provide clear, consistent tracking, status reporting, and communication to stakeholders and leadership, translating technical detail into concise updates on progress, risks, and trade\-offs.

**Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of relevant project or program management experience, with the majority spent leading complex, multi\-disciplinary software projects and programs.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* PMP, CSM, or a similar project management certification is a plus. An advanced degree in a business or technical field is a plus.
* Experience managing software development projects and programs in an Agile environment, coordinating delivery across multiple functions.
* Strong organizational skills with a proven ability to manage resources, schedules, risks, issues, and change requests.
* Experience supporting data platform, data engineering, or analytics initiatives is strongly preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; equally effective with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders.
Experience in HIPAA\-compliant healthcare or life sciences environments is a plus.  
*

*

jobs.title: Sr. Global Operations Manager
jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**



Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy\-sensitive AI\-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.



We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100\+ of the Fortune 500\), a $5\.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.



You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI\-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real\-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170\+ countries.

### **About the Role**



As the Senior Global Operations Manager of Fulfillment \& Outbound Logistics, you will own Verkada's global 3PL network and oversee inbound, warehouse, and outbound logistics operations across multiple regions. You'll be responsible for optimizing supply chain performance, managing strategic logistics partners, driving cost savings, and ensuring world\-class service levels. We're looking for an experienced operations leader who thrives in fast\-paced environments, enjoys solving complex supply chain challenges, and is passionate about building scalable global logistics processes.


### **What You'll Do**


* Own and manage strategic partnerships with global 3PL providers, including vendor selection, contract negotiations, performance management, and quarterly business reviews.
* Oversee inbound, warehouse, and outbound logistics operations across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve service levels across the supply chain.
* Develop and monitor KPIs including freight costs, inventory performance, order accuracy, fill rates, and on\-time delivery.
* Manage inventory deployment strategies, distribution network optimization, and reverse logistics (RMA/refurbishment) programs.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Supply Chain, Planning, Operations, and external logistics providers to resolve operational issues and improve execution.
* Establish and maintain supply chain SOPs while driving adoption of best practices across internal teams and 3PL partners.
* Lead implementation and optimization of supply chain systems, including WMS, TMS, and ERP integrations.
* Present operational performance, trends, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week.

### **What You Bring**


* 8\+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or operations management, including 5\+ years managing 3PL partnerships.
* Experience overseeing global logistics operations across multiple regions and international supply chains.
* Strong background in warehouse, transportation, fulfillment, and distribution network management.
* Experience with WMS, TMS, ERP platforms, and advanced Excel for reporting and data analysis.
* Proven success driving cost reduction initiatives and improving operational efficiency through process optimization.
* Experience managing vendor relationships, negotiating contracts, and holding logistics providers accountable to SLAs.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate data into operational improvements.
* Excellent communication and project management skills with experience leading cross\-functional initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field. APICS CSCP, Lean Six Sigma, or similar certifications are a plus.

### **Employee Benefits**



Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:


* Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well\-being needs \- Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
* Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
* Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee's 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary
* Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
* Expanded mental health support
* Paid parental leave policy \& fertility benefits
* Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
* Professional development stipend
* Wellness/fitness benefits
* Healthy lunches provided daily
* Commuter benefits

### **Additional Information**


* You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.

### **Verkada Is An Equal Opportunity Employer**



As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.


*Your application will be handled in accordance with our* *Candidate Privacy Polic

* Identify where AI tools, automation, lightweight systems, or simpler workflows can improve speed, consistency, and scale while preserving appropriate human judgment.

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Home Services Financing
jobs.description:
**Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media**



QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online **marketplaces that match searchers and "research and compare" consumers with brands**. We run these virtual\- and private\-label marketplaces in one of the nation's largest media networks.



Our industry leading segmentation and AI\-driven **matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster.** They allow brands to target and reach in\-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment\-by\-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.



Our campaign\-results\-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.



We believe in:


* The direct measurability of digital media.
* Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
* The advantages of technology.


We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world's biggest channel.

  


**Job Category**

  


360 Finance is seeking an experienced Business Analyst to optimize and expand our consumer\-financing marketplace. This role will translate lender performance, contractor demand, consumer credit profiles, and operational data into business decisions.



The Business Analyst will identify coverage gaps, growth opportunities, performance issues, and emerging risks. The ideal candidate combines financial\-services experience, analytical rigor, commercial judgment, and the ability to operate in a fast\-moving, high\-pressure "startup on steroids" environment.



This is not a reporting\-only role. This person will diagnose issues, recommend actions, and work across the organization to drive results.

  


**Responsibilities**

**Lender Coverage and Network Analytics**
* Evaluate lender coverage across FICO bands, loan amounts, states, trades, contractor segments, interest rates, terms, and product types.
* Identify contractor and consumer demand not adequately served by the lender network.
* Quantify the application, approval, funded\-loan, and revenue opportunity associated with closing coverage gaps.
* Recommend lender capabilities, products, or underwriting criteria to add or expand.
* Develop lender scorecards covering volume, approval rates, funded rates, pull\-through, loan size, speed, reliability, economics, and contractor experience.
* Determine whether prospective lenders provide incremental coverage or duplicate existing capabilities.
* Support lender reviews, commercial discussions, and partner prioritization with data\-backed recommendations.

**Risk Monitoring and Early\-Warning Analytics**
* Identify emerging risks across lender performance, contractor behavior, credit mix, consumer demand, operational service levels, fraud, compliance, and concentration.
* Detect changes in lender appetite, underwriting, approval rates, product availability, geographic coverage, or funding behavior.
* Partner with functional leaders to develop mitigation plans and track corrective actions.

**Contractor Demand and Opportunity Analytics**
* Determine which improvements would increase contractor adoption, application volume, funded volume, and retention.
* Partner with Sales and Account Management to identify opportunities and increase financing utilization.

**Operational and Financial Analytics**
* Monitor the financing funnel from contractor onboarding and application submission through approval, documentation, funding, and repeat usage.
* Identify funnel leakage, bottlenecks, performance anomalies, and root causes.
* Evaluate new lenders, products, pricing changes, partnerships, and strategic investments.
* Support planning, target setting, and performance management.
* Track performance against targets and explain key variances.

**Cross\-Functional Communication and Execution**
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, Account Management, Operations, Finance, Compliance, leadership, and external lenders.


  

**Requirements**
* 4\+ years of experience in financial services, fintech, consumer lending, marketplace analytics, business analytics, or strategy.
* Experience with consumer\-credit or lending products, preferably in home improvement, point\-of\-sale financing, unsecured lending, or embedded finance.
* Strong knowledge of credit segmentation, FICO bands, underwriting criteria, lender economics, and lending\-funnel metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to identify trends, anomalies, risks, and early warning indicators in complex data.
* Advanced SQL and Excel or Google Sheets skills.
* Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or a similar platform.
* Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and scenario\-analysis skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional decisions without direct authority.
* Strong ownership, urgency, judgment, and attention to detail.
* Experience with a multi\-lender marketplace or lender\-routing platform.
* Familiarity with home\-improvement financing and contractor distribution.
* Experience evaluating lender underwriting boxes and coverage gaps.
* Understanding of fair lending, compliance, fraud indicators, and data governance.
* Experience supporting lender negotiations or credit\-product expansion.
* Familiarity with statistical analysis, experimentation, or predictive modeling.

jobs.title: Senior Health Data Analyst I
jobs.description:
Overview:

The Senior Healthcare Data Analyst I contributes to the overall success of the organization by  

developing analytic solutions that support activities related to health services utilization  

management, care coordination, quality improvement and population health. Through analyzing  

patient claims, member enrollment, and other data, the Senior Healthcare Data Analyst  

participates in identifying progress, performance and opportunities for improvement on  

programs, quality of care, patient experience, and other metrics. This position requires a  

thorough understanding of healthcare data and workflows, combined with an extensive  

experience working with large data sets, conducting data analysis, including standard statistical  

software (SAS), and creating reports using Tableau.
Responsibilities:
* Works collaboratively with business partners, other analysts, and IT to gather and  

integrate data from disparate sources.
* Responds to ad hoc data requests from business units and leadership
* Assists in design and development of data collection strategies, aggregation, analysis,  

and reporting to ensure data integrity and enhance information value.
* Participates in design and interpretation of data analyses; provides recommendations for  

improvement of data quality and reporting.
* Helps build, manage, and/or enhance predictive models
* Assesses reporting and automation requirements and develops appropriate solutions.
* Maintains in\-depth knowledge of health plan operations, including claims processing,  

utilization management, quality improvement activities and pay for performance programs.
* Critically analyzes data, draws conclusions and effectively articulates results.
* Presents data and conclusions to non\-technical audience; uses data visualizations and  

summaries to highlight key findings.
* Creates and maintains thorough and consistent documentation of programs used to  

create reports.
* Manages and prioritizes workload while meeting deliverables and expectations.
* Works autonomously and collaboratively with report requestors, providing guidance to  

define report requirements and validate results.
* Works collaboratively across departments to understand and meet the organization’s  

analytic needs.

 **SECONDARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES*** Performs other assigned or needed activities required to assure success of the  

organization.
* Participates in special projects as needed.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**General Traits*** Passionate about data, willing to acquire new skills and knowledge, flexible, self\-motivated, and very curious.
* Creative problem\-solver, critical thinker, independent worker, data\-driven mentality.
* Communicates clearly and directly, relates well to others, engages people, provides and seeks feedback, articulates clearly, actively listens.


Qualifications:
**Education and Experience**  

Bachelor’s degree with concentration in health informatics, health administration, public health, computing, epidemiology, statistics or related field, Master’s degree preferred. Minimum four (4\) years of  

experience in data analysis and reporting. Knowledge of major health plan operations: healthcare claims processing, membership, provider, and benefits; or equivalent combination of education and experience.  

Excellent knowledge of data collection, analysis, statistics and data presentation with experience in data mining techniques and procedures. Experience using statistical packages for analyzing large data sets, SAS and/or SQL a plus. Experience working with administrative data, ideally health care data (Medicaid data a plus). Understanding of health data formats including claims, lab and pharmacy. Knowledge of clinical coding systems (e.g., ICD9, ICD10, CPT).

  

**Special Skills, Licenses and** **Certifications**  

Proficiency in inferential and predictive statistical analysis. MS Office, Excel, SQL, SAS, Tableau.  

Ability to present complex information in an understandable and compelling manner.

 **Performance Based Competencies**  

Ability to quickly acquire in\-depth knowledge of various systems related to claims processing, membership, provider, and benefits at Partnership. Strong written and oral communication skills with ability to interpret and  

understand technical requirements. Excellent analytical skills to troubleshoot and resolve data issues. Must be highly organized and proficient at multi\-tasking. Must be willing and able to provide gracious assistance to users, providers, and other constituents of Partnership.

 **Work Environment And Physical Demands**  

More than 50% of work time is spent at a video display terminal.

  

**All HealthPlan employees are expected to:**  

* Provide the highest possible level of service to clients;
* Promote teamwork and cooperative effort among employees;
* Maintain safe practices; and
* Abide by the HealthPlan’s policies and procedures, as they may from time to time be updated.

**HIRING RANGE:**

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst (Temporary)
jobs.description:
Simpson Strong\-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees.


Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong\-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956\. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.


Learn about our company culture directly from our team.

**YOU**
=======


This temporary 4–6\-month position offers an opportunity to play a critical role in advancing Talent Acquisition operations. As the Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst, you will serve as a strategic operations, analytics, and enablement partner for the Talent Acquisition team. You will translate recruiting data into clear insights, lead or support TA technology implementations, standardize processes and resources, and create scalable tools that improve hiring consistency, speed, quality, and candidate experience. This role partners closely with HR partners, hiring managers, HR operations, communications, and external vendors to turn strategy into practical execution.


This position requires a proactive, detail\-oriented problem solver who can manage complex projects, communicate clearly across audiences, troubleshoot systems and process gaps, and use data to influence continuous improvement across the recruiting lifecycle.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**
========================

**Talent Acquisition Analytics, Reporting and Insights (30%)**


Generate, analyze and communicate TA metrics that help leadership, recruiters, HR partners and business stakeholders understand recruiting performance, hiring trends and opportunities for improvement.

* Maintain and improve recurring and ad hoc reporting on requisition volume, time\-to\-fill/time\-to\-offer, offer approvals, source performance, recruiter workload, platform usage, referral and internal applicant activity, quality\-of\-hire inputs and early turnover trends.
* Prepare quarterly TA performance reviews, executive summaries, dashboards, and slide\-ready insights that highlight progress, risks, root causes and recommended actions.
* Maintain and enhance recruiter scorecards, operational tracking tools and KPI frameworks to support accountability, prioritization and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Analyze applicant funnel health, sourcing channel performance and location\-specific challenges to inform proactive sourcing, advertising and candidate flow strategies.

**TA Technology, Systems and Process Optimization (30%)**


Lead and support implementation, adoption and continuous improvement of TA systems and workflows, with a focus on scalable, compliant and user\-friendly recruiting operations.

* Serve as a key TA project partner for recruiting technology initiatives, including Paradox/Ty interview scheduling and referrals, SHL assessment integration, HiredScore implementation, Workday recruiting enhancements and related platform changes.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing, system troubleshooting, hypercare support, issue logs, enhancement requests, access questions and cross\-functional follow\-up with HR systems, IT and vendors.
* Partner with TA and business stakeholders to standardize intake forms, job description/job posting content, required vs. preferred skills mapping, stage definitions, candidate communications and disposition templates.
* Evaluate system adoption and process gaps, recommend improvements, and develop scalable solutions that reduce manual work, improve consistency and strengthen candidate and hiring manager experience.

**Program, Project and Change Management (25%)**


Plan, coordinate and execute TA programs and strategic initiatives from concept through rollout, ensuring stakeholders are aligned, resources are ready, and adoption is supported.

* Update and maintain the Talent Acquisition Playbook, Hiring Manager Portal resources, job aids, FAQs, templates, process documentation and operating standards for recruiters, HR partners and hiring managers.
* Develop and deliver training and change\-management materials for new TA processes and tools, including live sessions, My Workbench content, recordings, guides, communication drafts and follow\-up resources.
* Support structured interviewing, hiring events, dedicated interview pool pilots, first\-year turnover improvement work, candidate experience initiatives and quality\-of\-hire measurement efforts.
* Manage project plans, agendas, meeting cadences, action items and stakeholder updates to keep cross\-functional work moving and aligned to TA priorities.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Recruiting Operations Partnership (15%)**


Act as a central coordination point across TA, HR, business leaders and external partners to strengthen recruiting operations, vendor effectiveness and stakeholder experience.

* Partner with recruiters, HRBPs and hiring managers on recruiting process improvements, branch/location hiring challenges, priority requisitions and manager communication needs.
* Manage or support vendor relationships and utilization for platforms and partners such as Paradox, Workday, SHL, HiredScore, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed and related recruiting tools.
* Support recruiter and hiring manager enablement through clear communication, meeting facilitation, resource sharing, troubleshooting and escalation of system or process issues.
* Contribute to employer brand, employee referral, social media spotlight, community outreach and candidate communication initiatives that improve attraction and engagement.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Data Analytics, Communications, Organizational Development or a related field required.3\+years of experience in Human Resources:

jobs.title: Business Strategy Analyst, Commercial Operations
jobs.description:
**At CS Power Systems, we're on a mission to transform lives by delivering clean, solar\-powered electricity to millions worldwide—and we're just getting started.** As a cutting\-edge division of Canadian Solar, a global leader founded in 2001, we stand at the forefront of manufacturing high\-performance solar panels, inverters, and advanced energy storage solutions. In this fast\-growing, high\-impact industry, our deep commitment to sustainability drives everything we do, creating innovative technologies that power a brighter, greener future.

  

Across Canadian Solar's powerful ecosystem—including CS Power Systems, CSPowerTech, e\-STORAGE, Recurrent Energy, MSS, and CSI Solar—we're deeply invested in our people's success. If you're passionate about renewable energy and want to **"Make the Difference"** by building a lasting positive impact on the planet and communities everywhere, join us at **CS Power Systems**—where your talent can help shape the clean energy revolution.


Canadian Solar is seeking a **Business Strategy Analyst** to join our Commercial Operations team. This is a business\-focused strategy and commercial operations role supporting senior leadership with strategic planning, financial analysis, business performance management, and operational decision\-making.

  

The ideal candidate will bring experience from corporate strategy, management consulting, FP\&A, commercial operations, business operations, or operational excellence and will be comfortable evaluating business performance from both a financial and operational perspective.

  

This position will analyze P\&L performance, forecasts, business trends, market dynamics, and operational KPIs to identify opportunities and develop recommendations for leadership. The Business Strategy Analyst will also support annual and long\-range planning, business cases, strategic initiatives, and executive business reviews.

 **\*\*This is not an IT, software development, systems analyst, or data engineering position.**The emphasis is on applying financial and operational analysis to solve business problems and support commercial decision\-making.

 **Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Analyze business and financial performance, including revenue, profitability, P\&L results, budgets, forecasts, variances, and operational KPIs.
* Develop financial and operational models to support strategic planning, forecasting, resource allocation, investment decisions, and business performance management.
* Identify business trends, performance gaps, risks, and growth opportunities and translate findings into actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
* Support annual operating plans, long\-range strategic planning, monthly and quarterly business reviews, and other leadership planning activities.
* Develop business cases, scenario analyses, investment evaluations, and strategic recommendations for commercial and operational initiatives.
* Partner with Finance, Sales, Product Management, Operations, and Supply Chain to evaluate business performance and identify opportunities to improve profitability, productivity, scalability, and operational effectiveness.
* Conduct market, customer, industry, and competitive analysis to support commercial strategy and business planning.
* Prepare executive\-level presentations, performance scorecards, and management reporting that clearly communicate business results, trends, and recommendations.
* Support strategic initiatives and special projects from initial business analysis through recommendation and implementation.
* Present business insights and recommendations to senior leadership and key cross\-functional stakeholders.

 **Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Operations, Engineering, or a related business discipline required; MBA preferred.
* Minimum 3 years industry experience required. Experience at a leading consulting firm or investment banking a plus.
* Experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, FP\&A, strategic finance, business operations, commercial operations, or operational excellence strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of P\&L analysis, financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, business planning, and performance management.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex business problems and convert financial, operational, and market information into clear business recommendations.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen with an understanding of the factors that influence revenue, profitability, operating performance, and business growth.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, including financial modeling, business analysis, and executive\-level presentations.
* Experience developing KPIs, management scorecards, and executive reporting to support business performance discussions and decision\-making.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and interact effectively with senior leadership in a fast\-paced business environment.
* Experience supporting manufacturing, renewable energy, solar, energy storage, industrial, or infrastructure businesses is highly desirable.
* Second\-language proficiency in Chinese is a plus.

 **Compensation \& Benefits:**  

Canadian Solar offers a competitive salary plus fully comprehensive benefits and performance bonus package based on an annual objective achievement. Our generous benefits package includes a 401(k) Retirement Plan, medical/dental/life/disability program, PTO and sick days.

  

The pay range for this position is $105,000 – $130,000 USD. This range represents annual base salary only, without regard to location, and does not include bonus or other incentives or benefits that may apply. The pay range for this role is subject to change.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager (SaaS Implementations)
new_jobs.description:
Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed \& Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.


Bullhorn is a fast\-paced and dynamic environment where hard work and outstanding results are rewarded and celebrated. We value those that exhibit an eagerness to learn and a strong natural desire for continuous improvement and we encourage team members to stretch themselves, acknowledge challenges and learn from them. With a strong focus on growth, we provide ample opportunities for career development and prioritize promoting from within. We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.


**About the role**

The **Project Manager** is a key position within Professional Services and the PMO and acts with integrity and leads by example, serving as the primary point of contact throughout the customer engagement lifecycle. This role is accountable for ensuring the right resources, governance, and methodologies are in place to enable successful planning, execution, and delivery of complex core SaaS system implementations for our clients, ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, on budget, and with high CSAT scores.


In this capacity, the Project Manager partners closely with Customers, Sales Executives, Solution Consultants, Solution Architects, and Software Engineers to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and deliverables align with defined success criteria. By applying project management best practices and adhering to Bullhorn’s PMO processes, the Senior Project Manager defines, drives, and manages the delivery of projects, managing scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and stakeholder expectations to ensure an exceptional customer experience from project initiation through closure.  

  



**A typical day will include...**
---------------------------------

* **Owning the Project Lifecycle:** Lead the planning, execution, and closure of multiple, concurrent, large\-scale client software implementation projects, establishing the necessary governance and structure where none exists.
* **Proactively Drive Clarity and Order:** Quickly assess and gain command over complex, ambiguous, and high\-risk projects, translating chaos into defined, manageable, and executable project plans.
* **Ultimate Accountability:** Serve as the single point of accountability for project status and success. Naturally take ownership of problems and aggressively drive solutions to resolution.
* **Rigorous Risk and Scope Management:** Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks, dependencies, and issues. Firmly manage scope creep and hold both internal and client stakeholders accountable to agreed\-upon project plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Executive\-Level Communicatio** n: Manage client and vendor relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for project status, expectations, and issue resolution with executive and C\-level stakeholders.
* **Financial and Resource Control:** Oversee project budgets, tracking hours and expenses to ensure financial targets are met and providing accurate, predictable and insightful forecasting and reporting.
* **Methodology Adherence:** Apply project management best practices and actively contribute to the development, improvement and standardization of Bullhorn's PMO processes.
* Mentoring and provide guidance to junior project managers or implementation specialists on best practices and project governance.

**This role is a fit for you if...**
------------------------------------

* Have 3\+ years of progressive experience managing complex, external client\-facing software implementation projects, with a significant focus on ERP, HCM, CRM, or large\-scale SaaS solutions with billable utilization targets.
* A proven track record of successfully delivering projects that have a high level of complexity and ambiguity, demonstrating the ability to rapidly impose structure and governance.
* An expertise in defining and managing project scope, schedules, and budgets for large enterprise clients.
* A mastery of various project management methodologies ( *e.g.,* Waterfall, Scrum, Hybrid) and knowing when to apply each to achieve stability.
* A solid understanding of the end\-to\-end implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, configuration, data migration, integration, testing (UAT), and go\-live.
* Have a proficiency with modern project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, SmartSheet) and resource management systems.
* PMP, CSM, or equivalent is highly preferred.

The annual base salary range for this position is $92,002 \- $115,000\. In addition, this role is eligible for an annual target bonus \& a comprehensive benefits package.


**Compensation and Transparency Statement**

The posted range represents the good\-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. Actual pay within the range will be based on factors such as, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business or organizational needs and affordability. In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws we disclose salary ranges in all job postings and provide additional information upon request

new_jobs.description:
Company Overview: **Work Where it Matters**

  

Suvi, an Akima company, is not just another federal mission services contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

  

At Suvi, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

 **For our shareholders**, Suvi provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

 **For our government customers**, Suvi delivers subject matter experts, an agile management approach, and innovative technologies that accomplish customers’ missions safely, securely, and efficiently.

 **As a Suvi employee**, you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.


Description:

Suvi is seeking a Senior Program Manager responsible for the overall leadership, management, financial performance, and execution of multiple Federal Government contracts and task orders. The Senior Program Manager will ensure contractual requirements, customer expectations, staffing, financial objectives, schedules, deliverables, and quality standards are achieved. To join our team of outstanding professionals, apply today!

  

The successful candidate must operate with a high degree of independence, ownership, accountability, organization, and initiative and effectively manage multiple customers, contracts, personnel, and priorities simultaneously.


Responsibilities:
* Lead and manage multiple Federal contracts and task orders throughout the full contract lifecycle, including transition, planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout.
* Maintain accountability for program performance, including technical execution, staffing, schedule, financials, deliverables, quality, risk, security, and customer satisfaction.
* Manage contract financial performance, including revenue, profitability, forecasting, budgeting, staffing utilization, funding, and cost control.

* Lead customer meetings, program reviews, and internal management reviews.

* Manage employee timekeeping, travel, expenses, payroll coordination, and other personnel\-related program requirements.

* Identify, manage, and communicate program risks, issues, corrective actions and opportunities for improvement.

This remote position requires applicants to be located in or within a reasonable commuting distance of Huntsville, Alabama, as occasional meetings at the customer’s location are required.

new_jobs.description:
**Summary:**
Responsible for providing overall project management for Willis Lease during Lease Engine Returns, Engine Shop Visits and Engine Purchases to ensure the engines meet all FAA/EASA and Willis Lease requirements. The Project Manager, Technical Services provides the main interface between the Customer, the MRO and Willis Lease during the crucial lease return process. The Project Manager coordinates all aspects of the lease return process with all internal and external customers. This position requires the Project Manager to travel to the location of the engine and/or the records as necessary to manage the lease return process, shop visit or purchase of an engine.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Acts as the primary coordinator with Willis Lease Contracts, the Customer, the MRO, and Willis Lease Technical Records to facilitate an engine lease return.
* Acts as the primary point of contact with the customer during the lease return process including any coordination for customer on\-site or MRO visits. Sets up secondary points of contact within Willis Lease for the customer to facilitate engine lease returns.
* Utilizes the Willis Lease Technical Department Procedures to perform the requirements of an engine lease return at remote locations.
* Ensures work performed during the lease return is complete and complies with FAA, EASA and Willis Lease requirements.
* Attends, or delegates as appropriate, the test cell run or On\-wing tests, to ensure engine performance meets lease return requirements. If performance issues arise, the Project Manager is responsible for coordinating resolution with the MRO, Customer and Willis Lease.
* Attends, or delegates as appropriate, Post Test Borescope inspections to ensure serviceability of the engine prior to lease return and works with the Customer, MRO and OEM to resolve any discrepancies.
* Performs, or delegates as appropriate, a detailed inventory of the engine at end of lease to ensure all items shipped with the engine at start of the lease are returned. If any differences are noted, the Project Manager will work with Willis Lease Technical Records to acquire proper certification of installed units. The Project Manager works with the MRO, the Customer, or a Contractor to replace any missing parts in a cost\-effective manner.
* Reviews for accuracy and, as required, makes copies of all data generated by the Customer and the MRO during the lease return process so that the engine may be leased again in a timely manner.
* Acts as the primary coordinator for engine shop visits with the following duties:
* + prepares the work scope and attains a cost estimate from the MRO
	+ provides the MRO with all required data for the shop visit
	+ manages all aspects of the repair to ensure compliance with the work scope and to achieve a cost\-effective repair
	+ reviews the invoice and manages disputes if any
	+ dispositions all unserviceable material
	+ ensures the engine is properly packaged for shipment
* Assists in any other technical function to support the Company portfolio as may be required.
* Attend Industry conferences to stay current on engine programs.
* Other duties as assigned

 **Qualifications / Requirements:**

* A\&P license preferred. Minimum “P” required.
* 5\+ years of airline and/or engine shop experience.
* Experience with the CFM56 Series, LEAP\-1A and LEAP\-1B series, GEnx, GE90, PW4000 94” and 100”, CF6\-80, CF34 Series, and IAE V2500\-A5, engine models.
* Strong background in engine records. Position requires knowledge of Life Limited Parts status reports (Chapter 5\) and Airworthiness Directive status reports.
* Test cell, Engine repair and overhaul and Borescope experience required.
* Able to travel on short notice, for extended periods and globally.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel mandatory.
* Strong interpersonal skills including the ability to work well with different levels of management as well as different cultures.

 **Travel/Misc.:**

* Extensive global travel \- 150\+ days a year.

new_jobs.title: Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**



At Modernize (a QuinStreet division) our mission is to simplify home improvement by inspiring motivated homeowners and connecting them with qualified contractors. Our foundation is based on 20 years as a driving force as Home Improvement Leads in online lead generation – connecting homeowners with high–quality contractors – in the $500 billion annually grossing home improvement market. We're working hard on a new brand and new products to cater to homeowners and the most successful contractors in the industry.



We're looking for sharp, motivated individuals to join our growing team. Teammates who enjoy using technology to solve problems will thrive in our dynamic startup environment. We have an open floor plan that encourages the entire team to participate in critical discussions and allows everyone to be a vital contributing factor. You'll enjoy our hip, newly renovated office in the heart of downtown with a view of the capital and the downtown skyline.

**Job Category**

  


360 Finance is seeking an experienced Business Analyst to optimize and expand our consumer\-financing marketplace. This role will translate lender performance, contractor demand, consumer credit profiles, and operational data into business decisions.



The Business Analyst will identify coverage gaps, growth opportunities, performance issues, and emerging risks. The ideal candidate combines financial\-services experience, analytical rigor, commercial judgment, and the ability to operate in a fast\-moving, high\-pressure "startup on steroids" environment.



This is not a reporting\-only role. This person will diagnose issues, recommend actions, and work across the organization to drive results.

  


**Responsibilities**

**Lender Coverage and Network Analytics**
* Evaluate lender coverage across FICO bands, loan amounts, states, trades, contractor segments, interest rates, terms, and product types.
* Identify contractor and consumer demand not adequately served by the lender network.
* Quantify the application, approval, funded\-loan, and revenue opportunity associated with closing coverage gaps.
* Recommend lender capabilities, products, or underwriting criteria to add or expand.
* Develop lender scorecards covering volume, approval rates, funded rates, pull\-through, loan size, speed, reliability, economics, and contractor experience.
* Determine whether prospective lenders provide incremental coverage or duplicate existing capabilities.
* Support lender reviews, commercial discussions, and partner prioritization with data\-backed recommendations.

**Risk Monitoring and Early\-Warning Analytics**
* Identify emerging risks across lender performance, contractor behavior, credit mix, consumer demand, operational service levels, fraud, compliance, and concentration.
* Detect changes in lender appetite, underwriting, approval rates, product availability, geographic coverage, or funding behavior.
* Partner with functional leaders to develop mitigation plans and track corrective actions.

**Contractor Demand and Opportunity Analytics**
* Determine which improvements would increase contractor adoption, application volume, funded volume, and retention.
* Partner with Sales and Account Management to identify opportunities and increase financing utilization.

**Operational and Financial Analytics**
* Monitor the financing funnel from contractor onboarding and application submission through approval, documentation, funding, and repeat usage.
* Identify funnel leakage, bottlenecks, performance anomalies, and root causes.
* Evaluate new lenders, products, pricing changes, partnerships, and strategic investments.
* Support planning, target setting, and performance management.
* Track performance against targets and explain key variances.

**Cross\-Functional Communication and Execution**
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, Account Management, Operations, Finance, Compliance, leadership, and external lenders.


  

**Requirements**
* 4\+ years of experience in financial services, fintech, consumer lending, marketplace analytics, business analytics, or strategy.
* Experience with consumer\-credit or lending products, preferably in home improvement, point\-of\-sale financing, unsecured lending, or embedded finance.
* Strong knowledge of credit segmentation, FICO bands, underwriting criteria, lender economics, and lending\-funnel metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to identify trends, anomalies, risks, and early warning indicators in complex data.

At FUJIFILM North America Corporation, we are many things to both consumers and business customers. We’re looking for passionate, mission\-driven people to help us continue to innovate.

  

  

With five operating divisions, there’s a lot of opportunity to find your niche and make an impact. Perhaps you’ll click with our Imaging Division that provides one\-time\-use cameras, digital printing equipment, and instax™. Maybe you’ll get charged up about our Electronic Imaging Division that markets digital cameras, lenses, and accessories for content creators. Or, you might have your eye on our Optical Devices Division, which provides optical lenses for the broadcast, cinematography, videography, and industrial markets. You could be drawn to our Business Innovation Division—they develop office and commercial print solutions and enable digital transformation.
